notes.title: The Sturdy Update (0.8.1) | Player Ranks and Big Fixes!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/34bf22e6ff83c11ee232db609ad89c0d42f462c8.png

Anchors away for July's official content update! This month is all about hardiness, sturdiness, and long-term stability. A new ranking system, menu, and a long list of 50+ overdue fixes awaits below! Drop your anchor and check it out!

Features

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0f75790c2e61cb134cce6d1cafcd11c6fb36c664.png

New Player Rank System! - Introducing Player Ranks to We Need To Go Deeper! As part of our efforts towards making meta-progression feel more satisfying, you now earn XP on your future runs that build towards earning new Ranks for your character! 

Ranks show off your Deeper prowess and are shown next to your character's name in online games. As of now, there are a total of 11 Ranks to earn, with 5 sub-ranks to earn in between each, totaling at 55 potential rankings! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/972df2dca05b3139a8ba68dac3f8dab35b260285.png

Ranks don't simply come with a new fancy badge, however, as we've revamped the method for unlocking items and cosmetics to now be tied to our new XP system as well, so you'll be regularly unlocking cool stuff each time you level! 

Note: If you've already unlocked everything you still get to keep the things you've unlocked.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a0790b90262cccfc841feafe3c34710348fdc9f3.png

Also, DON'T PANIC. We know what you're thinking when you look at this new Gift Box on our XP screen, and to clarify - these are NOT the loot boxes your grandpa warned you about. 

While the rest of the game industry may have ruined the joy of opening a digital gift, we opted for this context because it's fundamentally FUN to unlock things in gift box form, but we promise this will never be tied with any kind of micro-transaction, purchasable currency, nada. The in-game XP or Gold will not be monetized in any way, shape or form, rest assured. Everything is to be earned in-game, exclusively.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d749e2b3708f05185a69abe50419858f9b3aec33.png

New Main Menu! - The main menu has finally recieved a much-needed facelift after getting increasingly cluttered for so long, and in doing so we got to include a lot of cool new stuff to help the community grow! 

Latest News is now more prominently featured with a new rotating set of links that will direct folks to info about new Updates, Events, Merch, or Community hubs! There is also a new space for other useful links in the bottom right, and an ever-enticing reminder of your current XP progress and ranking in the upper right. 

Your character also gets a moment to shine the moment you open the game now, just to remind you of your handsome self.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/205fcd2658ffe74914d9d800314881c4308974e6.png

Sturdy Fixes Galore! - You asked, and you asked, and sometimes things slide by. This month, we decided enough is enough, and went hard at work fixing as many long-standing issues as we could. It may not be as sexy as more content, but sometimes what's underneath is just as important.

THE BIG FIX & CHANGE LIST:

- Internal Restarting is FIXED! No more program restarts between playthroughs!
-Fixed "the infinite void" bug. You can no longer find yourself in a black abyss of truly desolate nothingness - even if you want to.
-Fixed costumes getting shifted around every time we add a new cosmetic. Ryan is a hero.
-Fixed players getting their heads stuck on low spaces even when crouching
-Players now only lose one max health on death rather than two!
-Civilization shops now offer handheld weapons in addition to their usual repertoire!
-You can no longer pick up a non-stackable upgrade. You can buy it, sure, but uh, I mean you do you buddy.
-You can no longer revive someone after walking away from their dead body. Goodbye, beloved hack.
-The sniper mod finally deals the monstrous damage it's supposed to! Check that baby out!
-Fixed shotgun and sniper mod text not appearing after picking up the upgrades
-Fixed shop cases still showing their item for sale even after being bought or broken
-The time devourer can no longer show up to ruin your day before the game loops.
-Oh, and the time devourer is no longer armored.
-Oh, and the time devourer is very much so mortal now. Kill him. See what happens. See if another just shows up immediately. Be my guest.
-Fixed relics turning gray like ragdolls.
-Fixed players being able to see beyond the loaded level space in the tactical view.
-Fixed the bug where the lair guardian could permanently disarm players
-On that note, disarming has been completely rewritten to make permanent disarms virtually impossible.
-In the same manner, locking your player in place was rewritten too. You should find yourself to be less...sticky?
-You can no longer pick up two items simultaneously. 
-Fixed multiple sources of gold and items failing to properly save, and even being outright rewritten with nothing.
-Fixed missing networking on ice chunks, abomination spawners, and barnacle mines which were potentially causing packet buildup
-Networking channel settings have been changed to allow fragmented data in the channel responsible for spawning objects. This is useful for players joining mid-game who need a whole lotta data at once. 
-Manowar enemy now properly appears in front of a player's face when attached their head.
-Fixed oddly laid out catalog menu items by runtime rescaling
-Fixed a bug where a player grabbed out of the submarine by a lair guardian would trigger the submarine hatch sound and do a fade to black over and over and OVER.
-Remember those weird artifacts on the health UI? How about other UI? Nick is your man and he has delivered the fix. 
-Bots now only flash yellow when they've actually healed. It's a miracle, people.
-Fixed ceiling-walking enemies not falling when they're supposed to
-Fixed ceiling walker y-scaling problems
-All enemies attached to your head now scale correctly. *Phew*. Didn't want my head having any weird upside-down stuff on it.
-Removed all item and cosmetic unlocks caused by  raw depth, item use, or weird weird poorly explained external stuff. Gotta use that XP baby!
-Fixed players being able to move, swing their arms, and shoot while in the loadout menu
-Players no longer fire off a packet every frame when holding the interact button next to a door. Hallelujah.
-Fixed a bug where players who had super fast hard disks would find themselves stuck in the ceiling of the Espadon. Classy.
-Fixed a bug where players would be unable to use the periscope after being brigged while on a console or in bed.
-Exterior level chunks now have double the variety at no extra cost! How? Embarrassingly simple math magic.
-As mentioned in the last content drop, all bosses now have 50% less health, and their health no longer scales with the number of crew members. 
-Periscope view size reduced 10%
-Fixed the Espadon background to no longer have a teeeeeeny sliver of exterior world that you could see.
-The darkness (or lighting surface) and exterior parallax water are now big enough to accommodate the largest boss camera size without showing beyond them
-Removed a needless additional check for internet connection and confirmed that you have internet if you are able to get your public IP. This fixes the problem where players can get this "not able to connect to steampowered.com" error even after disabling UPNP usage.
-Fixed a memory cleanup bug when removing bots before starting a game
-Fixed mummy ragdoll not showing up after being killed on client machines
-Players can no longer revive multiple skeletons at once
-Fixed several visual glitches in civilizations which allowed players to see beyond boundaries or see blank background
-Grabbing multiple upgrades no longer shows the wrong text
-Increased the shot distance on the sniper modded exterior gun
-Fixed players still getting hit by higher-aimed projectiles even when they're ducking
-RESOLUTION OPTIONS EVERYBODY HALLELUJAH!
-Fixed several cases where players get stuck on sharp corners in caves.
-Particle system setup has been made much more efficient.
-Fixed a typo in the Bobby Suit description.
-Players using Discord or Steam to join a game with a different version will no longer succeed. This fixes incompatible versions with totally different networking from trying to mash together like malformed puzzle pieces until they both break.
-Fixed a particle factory error in the main power console switch
-No longer will you be shackled to the play menu if you have a public IPv4 but are still trying to get a public IPv6! This fixes a case of permanent "Waiting for public IP source"!
-Fixed a serious bug where players were never leaving their Steam lobbies in the first place. This was causing lobbies to appear full and de-list from the lobby browser even when space was available.
-Fixed a bug where players disagreed on which submarine they had actually traveled in when it came time to upload their scores to the leaderboard. Oh boy. How embarrassing.
-The cheat checker should no longer flag odd rapid changes in values that it tracks. Instead, it will now look for absurd values, which is a safer marker for cheating.
-Fixed being able to enter/leave the submarine while chatting after reaching a cave
-Fuel barrels now refill 50% of the sub's fuel meter!
-The X on the relics UI should be working again. How it fell into disrepair is a matter of scholarly debate to this day.
-Players should now have afflictions removed in the bed when at full health. We had forgotten to account for the effect of health potions when doing the math on that.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Community

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png

::: Player of the Month :::

The Player of the Month for July is..... Thor Odenson!

Not only has Thor Odenson been an active player since release, he's also been a moderator on our Discord for quite some time! Thor Odenson is quick to help others on our channel, as well as join them in online games. If you've ever taken a dive with him, you'd know that he is a skilled player and has a lot of useful insight and tactics to share. Thank you, Thor Odenson! I don't know how we'd do it without you!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, let us know what y'all think of the new update! Happy ranking!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch 1 fixes:
-Fixed the loading/saving problems brought on by trying to fit rank data into an old holder class. This should fix another large swath of cases where gold and depth are completely lost! Unfortunately, any save files which were damaged before this fix will not be repaired by it. This only prevents future damage from occurring to gold, depth, and rank save data.
-Fixed rank-based catalog items not showing up properly.
-Players can no longer go over the rank of captain.
-The internal restart system is drastically more tolerant to errors, including any possible from saving/loading really old versions of game files.
-Shop cases can no longer be infinitely mined for gold.
-Fixed a bug that caused the screen to go dark forever if a lair guardian destroyed the submarine.
-Switched to a much safer style of serializing game save data which does not cause the file to remain open even if an error is thrown.
-Each new game resets the seed for the random number generator to fix cases where the same first biome was seen generating over and over until application quit.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch 2 fixes:
-Your resolution now defaults to the max one available on your monitor.
-Fixed the game resolution getting reset when entering the play menu.
-Fixed a problem where a bug in the first time loading resolution settings could cause them to never save.
-Removed event-specific items from the catalog.
-Removed eldritch staff from the catalog.
-Fixed incorrect rank requirements on the water pump.
-Added a hotkey (default caps-lock) to turn off hard mouse cursor boundaries.
-Mouse cursor boundaries are only enforced in windowed mode.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch 3 fixes:
-Found and fixed a missing networked object which wasn't spawning on the server end and causing networking backup (this time it was the skeleton for recruited civilization crew members).
-Fixed an error preventing deletion of particle emitters when the scene changed.
-Fixed a null reference exception when using the water pump over the network.
-Fixed the bug where the tactical view could be turned on and off when chatting while using the periscope.
-Fixed a casting error when trying to access old player stats files.
-Fixed a regression allowing a fifth invisible player into a lobby.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch 4 fixes:
-Fixed the sunhat appearing in the catalog even after purchase
-Made even more failsafes for getting the submarine positioned correctly after a biome change (see fix for "endless void" bug)
-Fixed a missing networked object - today it was the ghost explosion for ghost hammerheads!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Patch 5 fixes:
-Fixed still getting gold and XP even in a custom game
-Fixed a logic error in XP progress calculations. After you finish a game for your first time in patch 5, the level up bar animation may be slightly incorrect, but this is likely getting extra experience added back to you caused by times you previously saw yourself level up but went back to the menu and found yourself at the same rank. Each game after the first should have the level up bar at the end of the game correctly reflecting the XP added.
-Fixed an exploit where players could join and leave a game over and over and get expeirence each time they leave. XP is now only given and saved at the end of a run. If you disconect during a run, your gold and depth are still saved so long as it is not a custom game. Reconnecting before the game ends will ensure you still get the full amount of XP for the entire run. It is simply awarded only once.

notes.title: Version 0.8.1 BETA is Live! (UPDATED)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! The BETA for our latest content update is now live for you to test! We say Beta because one of the biggest fixes this update brings is a real doozy, and we won't feel comfortable pushing the update out until we know it's stable.

SO - if you would like to help test the new update, simply right click WNTGD in your Steam Library and go to Properties > Betas and select the "beta" branch from the dropdown list and wait for the content to download.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING TO TEST (UPDATED):

- Our new "internal restart" system, AKA our solution for not having to force the program to quit and reboot at the end of each session to function properly. How do we test this? Simple, play many games in a row without restarting the game, and report anything strange that happens from the second game onwards.

vvv UPDATED! vvv

- LAN should be fixed, so if it's broken, or some combination of it and Online games are broken, let us know!

- Ranks and XP should be pretty much working now. There's one known bug where new ranks don't display properly on clients that we're looking into, but start earning XP and see what happens!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thanks everyone! With your help, hopefully we'll be able to test/fix the update and release it in full in no time!

notes.title: The Heavy Load Update (0.8) | Boss Lairs, Branching Paths and More!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/e3035fceccc611afbba33658d5b61c2ba748d79b.png

Things are getting heavy with June's official content update! This update we're overhauling expedition zones with revamped drop rates, a new boss encounter, an all new expedition type, and more! Read on to find out what we have in store!

Features

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/583f61682bef298d33b26a9fda56b9f8a034ed9e.png

New Expedition Type: Lairs! - These mysterious new expedition types have begun to appear in the trench; abandoned undersea workshops filled with abandoned tech, including a precious Upgrade Crate! But be warned, for these valuable Upgrades are guarded by....

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2088ccef80ecfb4b1d054650a6ca8e02870ddd6c.png

New Boss: Lair Guardians! - These hulking masses of abandoned copper and iron are set to crush any and all intruders who dare try and take their precious cargo. But don't be fooled by their size, Lair Guardians also come equipped with all kinds of dangerous gadgetry to put a stop to your crew. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/1c282ef7b32e5b25abde617aec03f90b7f8644e7.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/637fc0207b2c63cb8d8342a7d87c2c48db1090a6.png

Branching Paths! - Take careful notice of your Radar, because on your travels you may notice that occasionally you'll come across branching paths that will determine what kind of Expedition you come across. Will you explore a Cave for resources and treasure? Or will you enter a Lair and fight for a new Upgrade? Choose wisely, for once you pick a path, quick-moving water currents will ensure you won't be able to return.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/31c0a89b8a5f7e544416320e4d4b5ffc8c9b999f.png

Ruby Chests! - With Lairs holding the key to ship Upgrades, Caves just got a lot more wealthy! These huge golden treasure troves are stashed away at the end of caves, holding within them a large stash of valuable Rubies, ensuring your future cave expeditions will be lucrative ones.

Balance

- Caves no longer contain Upgrade Crates.
- Caves have a much lower chance of producing long or second floor caves, with the probability increasing the deeper you go.
- Crate Hermit crabs have been replaced with Barrel Hermit Crabs in caves.
- Dodge rolling now has proper Dark Souls style invincibility frames!
- Volcanic boulders now fall a little slower to give more time to react.
- Zoomed out the tactical view 40% more.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Community

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png

::: Player of the Month :::

The Player of the Month for June is..... Natedog251!

Natedog251 was recently promoted to Moderator in our Community Discord, and for good reason! Always helpful among the Discord helping other users with their problems, and even better - hosting open invite games in the Discord quite regularly! Helping keep our multiplayer community thriving is an oft-overlooked contribution, but all the more important for little indie games like ours! So thank you, Natedog251 for everything you do!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, let us know what y'all think of the new update! Good luck not getting smashed to a pulp!

notes.notes:

This week's content drop we're bringing you guys a new affordable and frankly overdue outfit in the form of the First Mate uniform! And what better way to show off your first matey-ness than to get flat drunk off our new and improved Elixirs, now with zero side effects!

notes.title: The Jimmy-It Update (0.7.9) | New Weapons, Ammo Mods & More!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/c448508ba4332450d42dbe2a695681278e558434.png

Mix, match and shake it up for The Jimmy-It Update! This update is all about Weapons and Weapon Modifications, along with a whole host of fixes, options, and more! Read on for details!

Features

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/b64ecae2fff6eff81ae0d5e8450d5653659f71e4.png

Ammo Mods! - Spruce up your firepower with Ammo Mods! These 5 new weapon-altering upgrades will take your Torpedoes to the next level! And best of all- they can be mixed and matched together for synergizing results!

Rocket Booster - Blasts your torpedoes at terrible speeds, and gives direct hits an extra explosive damage boost! 

Acid Tank - Explosions leave an acidic cloud that will continously harm any enemy that dares come into contact.

Homing Dish - Directs your torpedoes to curve at will towards the nearest foe!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f6aaf26466d9c8f4740477b32afecb33715b10de.gif

Liquid Nitrogen Tank - Explosions leave an icy cloud that will slow any enemy in its wake!

Guidance Laser - A bright red laser lets you aim with precision!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/de17292ab81c117c6708a212617e0418019fd0eb.gif


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/987c1933d64830604516bc4420a8c8b9eeadb59e.png

2 New Swappable Submarine Weapons! - Mini-Gun firing ain't your style? Fear not, for the secondary infinite Sub Weapon slot just got tactical! When found, you can swap out your Mini-Gun for one of these two new weapon types!

Spread-Shot - The Spread-Shot will spray out several bullets at a time, allowing you to deal 4 times as much damage to any enemy that comes close enough to its short range.

Long-Shot - The Long-Shot lets you fire deadly precision shots from afar, though it takes greater skill to utilize.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/082dab84b2b12ae411167a2010a884b049b3dd26.png

New Community Requested Options! - You asked for them, so here they are! Two new options that let you better customize your game experience!

"Safe" Dynamite - Tired of trolls blowing up your Submarine? In "Safe" Dynamite mode, dynamite deals zero damage to fellow players, bots, and vessels! This new option can be found in the Custom Game Options sub-menu in any Lobby!

Legacy UI - If our new Console UI isn't your style, you can now enable the classic borderless and console-less UI under Options in the Main Menu!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/83ef856fb6ab2c6cc610251fa79fde9d4ed53557.png

Boss Cam - Boss Battles just got more grandeur with our new smarter Boss cam! The Boss cam gives you a better view of your gargantuan foe, and even tracks them so your team can better focus on destroying them instead of trying to see them.

Fixes

- Fixed "permanant curtains" loading bug.
- Fixed several main menu toggles not showing their saved value correctly as the default.
- Improved Cheat Detection, changed punishment from closing the Application to disabling saving of Leaderboards, Gold and Unlocks.
- Fixed player loadout info sometimes displaying incorrectly.
- Bots no longer fire at volcanic vents.

Balance

- Reduced price of all items in Civilization shops by 25%
- Fuel pickup rate dropped 50%
- Fuel amount per pickup dropped ~ 40%
- Reduced ammo amount received from drops by 33%
- Translation Book now reduces Civilization shop prices by 50%
- Reset the leaderboards to reflect all the new balance changes

Other

- Added "bullet trails" to projectile weapons.
- Added "kickback" to projectile weapons.
- Enemy Corpses turn gray to distinguish them from living enemies.
- Bumped up default zoom on exterior camera ~6%
- Scaled up the exterior torpedo so that we can see some more of those sweet details.


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png

Player of the Month

The Player of the Month for May is..... Cleanworld!

Cleanworld has been an ever-present voice among the WNTGD community for quite some time now, providing regular feedback, commentary and engagement with others in the community, and to the point keeping our forums lively throughout some of the more quiet months. Thank you, Cleanworld, and congratulations!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, let us know what y'all think of the new update! Jimmy away!

notes.title: The Wham Bam Update (0.7.8) | Dodge Rolls, Charge Attacks & More!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/02740211212fd95b15f55dd1c45adb1f9e366ab1.png

Bring the pain for April's content update! This month is all about improving the act of dishing it out and taking it! Dodge rolls, Charge Attacks and more! Read on for details:

Features

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/4ca38697d43a6b3fb12fed15c296ca84095f47db.gif

Dodge Rolls! - Keep yourself away from danger with the brand new Dodge Roll ability! At any time during combat, or just for fun, you can perform a quick roll by pressing the direction you want to roll towards, and hitting SPACE BAR! 

Warning: May cause back problems later in life.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0100a47c89ec9245294f048d7ad8e292b8dbc1b1.png

New Enemy - Baby Crabs! - These new tiny critters can be found just about anywhere, but not to worry - as they're almost useless! To satisfy your newfound bloodlust, we've included these new cannon-fodder enemies whose sole purpose in life is to be killed by the dozens.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d26f473815a4c8a2689ae0fbaea0577216ec9d13.png

Permanent Corpses! - Enemy corpses will no longer disappear! So what does this mean? Well for starters, it means you'll be able to tell where you have and haven't been in caves by the trails of bodies you leave behind, but more importantly, it means you're going to have to SWAB THE DECK if you want to keep a tidy Submersible! 

What's the saying, again? Cleaniness, by smacking corpses until they explode, is close to godliness.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/81d0eb1dc3b646d022a1318dd4e895517c5bc626.gif

Charge Attacks! - It's time to bring down the hammer with CHARGE ATTACKS, now available in every Melee Item! Now, when you HOLD the attack button, you'll rear back your weapon, charging it for a stronger blow!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d6c2c2605e2615503064ae98b732f8ae47fb24fc.png

Feedback Frenzy! - Along with the new mechanical changes to combat, we've also included a bevvy of smaller, but still important, changes to how basic combat FEELS:

- Added a visual "Swipe" animation to all melee attacks to add some oomph.

- Enemy corpses now get pushed back in the direction they were killed for more satisfying deaths.

- Enemies now get pushed back even more when taking damage to give some extra weight to attacks.

- MORE blood particles!

Fixes

- Fixed loads of enemy ragdolls which were setup to be networked but had no networked creation or destruction.
- Disabled old fuel UI (oops).
- Fixed an animation bug causing players to get stuck in tight spaces.
- Fixed a bug where cave jellyfish could make light objects without deletion if left for extremely long durations.
- Fixed crouch animation disrupting head collider's ability to fit under small spaces.

Other

- Added a setting to disable automatic port forwarding (used in rare cases where network administration drops your internet connection when UPNP is detected).
- Changed gear sounds to be more metallic in weapons console UI.
- Radar now has a pinging sound.
- Jumping now has a kickoff sound.
- New civilization music from Jacob Lives!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png

Player of the Month

The Player of the Month for April is..... Bee!

Throughout March, one person has been sending us regular and incredibly detailed bug/log reporting that has helped us immensely in tracking down some sticklers, and that person is Bee! Thanks to your reports, we have a much clearer understanding of some of the behind-the-scenes troubles! On top of helping us track down bugs, Bee has also created one of our favorite pieces of fan art in the form of their Espadon plushie, for those who haven't seen it yet:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1280611992
Thanks again, Bee, and congratulations!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, let us know what y'all think of the new update! Happy smashing!

notes.title: Crate Update #8: The Touch Crate & Spring Event (0.7.7)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/84449d0b3c618d54587015d17a06922903fe245f.png

Reach out and touch this month's new Crate Update - filled to the brim with a brand new UI. the Spring Event, and a special suprise! Details below.

Features

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f8effbb455a7fbefa2ab1265be83fb6fff14f69b.png

"Tangible" Console UI! - To better sell the fantasy of working together to run your big, bulky vessel, and in order to better teach new and returning players many of Deeper's quirks and mechanics, we've introduced new custom interfaces for every console! 

Now, when using your Periscope, your Navigation Console, or a Weapons console, you'll be greeted with a custom-made panel to represent your character's console controls! We're confident this will lead to better immersion and clarity overall, and looks nifty to boot!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/19881e4b583930af4bf3d0f379c990c3d28cee2d.png

vvvv [APRIL FOOLS 2018] vvvv

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/c619114dff0370fa2df8aaf6fd331bb4499f2f72.png

All New Battle Royale Mode! - We know a [strike]cash grab[/strike] game design opportunity when we see one, and what would suit our game better than an on-foot PvP mode?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/ebcc1f28a8b3cb29e3f2722238557d69cea4cdb9.png

Set on The Mysterious Island, up to 50 players will find themselves having to battle for survival in an innovative last-man-standing game mode! Starting out naked, players will have to scavenge for clothes and weapons, and take eachother out until only one victor remains!

We're very proud of this new mode, and we hope you'll like it too!

^^^^ [APRIL FOOLS 2018] ^^^^

Spring Event

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/622b4c95cf40ca9b9252f57a6bfa601b03f366e7.png

The Spring Event is Live!
6 Special Cosmetics!
 Mutant Egg Hunt!
 Hopping Abominations!
Spring has sprung, and so has Dr. Moreau's mutant hybrids! Sprung into the ocean, that is! Now, Dr. Moreau's sick experiment is swimming about leaving Mutant Eggs, most of which bear its twisted spawn, but some eggs contain the Festive Heads of Dr. Moreau's previous experiments! Don't ask why.  
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/9f604b19dedc2fcddbe8fb2ed012d62d4e21f84c.png
Dr. Moreau's experiments will expire spontaneously April 15th.

Fixes and Tweaks

- Added dust clouds to player movement to make running around slightly more satisfying.

- Fixed battery not correctly disarming players when grabbed.

- Fixed boss names not showing up.

- Fixed a bug which allowed players to hammer on the cannon type switch button and make the cannon disappear altogether.

- Made null checks on several SyncVar hooks. 

- Menu music now loops.

- Added Update Announcement section to Main Menu.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Well that's it for now! Let us know what you guys think of the update as always! Happy Hunting!

notes.title: The Sensations Update (0.7.6) | Tactical View, Linux Support & More!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/8d62b70cf625f00d4340bbe423fa74287b152328.png

Clean out yer ears and rinse your goggles for the Sensations Update! This month is all about displays and useful info for your future voyages, including an all-new Tactics View for Periscope users, and all-new Linux OS support! Read on for the sweet deets.

Features

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/4cb970fb3bcc724d55ef70f226278234c4480ddd.png

Tactical Periscope View!

This all-new Radar-like view can now be accessed from the Periscope at the press of a button! (Spacebar by default) 

The Tactical View will allow you to see further ahead than your Navigator or Weapons Specialist, giving you the insight your crew needs to make better decisions about where to go next, where the next expedition may lie, and where danger is lurking.

Furthermore, the tactical view displays a bevy of info regarding your vessel. From hull integrity, to fuel, to ammunition and power levels.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/3bc2342bbc6b30b4f51b57a589303069ee2e9162.png

Linux OS Support!

Penguins rejoice, for Linux and Steam OS Support is here! Spread the word to your command-console-using friends, and tell them to come join the party!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0c795df33c91b2d56cba46ce8ae0a058f148572a.png

 In-Game Resolution Options!

This one's long overdue, but hey - maybe we'll get partial credit for turning in late. Say goodbye to the days where holding Alt before beginning the game is necessary for changing your resolution! No longer will you have to harness the secrets of the game just to change your picture size. Hi Ma! I'm a real game now!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/5542bd52ed25958f4571a1fdb16f903bdb91cbc9.png

Lonesome Secret

Finally, a new secret hat has been added to the game. For those with a keen eye and especially for those who frequent our streams, this image is the only clue you'll need to unlock it.

Bug Fixes

- Fixed in-game UI not scaling properly on different aspect ratios. No more squishing!

- Fixed menus not scaling properly on dif. aspect ratios as well! Consistency all around!

-  Moved our Discord DLLs to the plugins folder, hopefully ensuring that we see fewer missing DLL exceptions being thrown.

- Added better exception handling for the Discord integration.

- Fixed some cases of pop-in spawning on environmental hazards and enemies.

- Fixed game starting at the wrong resolution. It should be a lot better at detecting your native resolution from the start now.

- Added camera effects for exterior view to bring back some of the original assets' saturation and color.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png

::: Player of the Month :::

Our Player of the Month this time around is MrMountainMan!

MrMountainMan has consistently been friendly, funny, and helpful no matter where he's found. In the Forums he's often found participating in other discussions, offering feedback, or offering help to new users.  In our inbox he's been helpful in solving bugs, frequently sending output logs to the Deli Interactive email, which is never not going to be notable given how useful it can be for us! In our streams, he's consistently present and helping keep our chat lively and active, and sometimes helping keep us on track when we start going off the rails! Thank you for everything you've been doing MrMountainMan, and congratulations!

notes.title: Crate Update #7: The Bug Crate (0.7.3)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/1f2c17e72487a0f3c98b3fbdebf274d7817735cf.png

This update is chock-full of bug fixes and balance features, all reported and requested by you guys! Figured a bit of cleanup work was to be done, so Jordan and Ryan went ahead and squashed as many problems as they could find these past few weeks!

Fixes/Improvements:

-AI crew members' pathfinding process is now multithreaded, which is a heck of a lot quicker.

-Every remote procedure call in our code base has been carefully modified to ensure exceptions are handled with every reference and error reporting is dramatically improved (log files are now even more useful for networking bugs!)

-Kicking players mid-game! The third time a player is brigged they are kicked out of the game completely! *Please* use only on abusive players rather than newbies - we reserve the right to remove this feature if it is making the game impossible to play for newer players.

-Fixed a bug in AI crew member task allocation causing them to only want to revive the host, but not clients, while in expeditions.

-Fixed periscopes remaining after entering a cave.

-Fixed players being able to move and use items when in the bed during expeditions.

-Fixed a bug where mid-game joining players would never see wall barnacles as hatched if they had hatched before joining (the barnacles kept growing too - hoo boy).

-Made a failsafe to ensure that mid-game joining players' sea backgrounds and rock sprites all match up with the current biome.

-Fixed a bug where a player could use their weapons and a battery after leaving the brig.

-Fixed a bug in AI crew member pathfinding causing them to take straight-up comical paths, flip around erratically, etc.

-Fixed a bug where two matches coming from the same public IP could cause the wrong one to be joined.

-Fixed several default cosmetics not being unlocked (Steward Standard anyone?)

-Optimized netcode to use ~95% fewer "Find" functions, which are notoriously slow in Unity.

-Gold now displays upon entering civilizations.

-The gold meter is much more fast and responsive.

-Upgraded Unity version to 2017.3 to get the latest Unity Multiplayer fixes (including an enticing set of fixes related to double-sending and double-receiving remote procedure calls).

-Upgraded NAT punchthrough tool and provided it with better reference/exception handling.

-Upgraded Steam API to latest available version.

-Clam hitboxes are much more fair now.

-Fixed a bug where hull breaches in certain areas of the Requin were inaccessible by AI crew members.

-Fixed AI crew members falling through the floor on revival.

-Fixed a bug where mid-game joining players could have 100% opaque green overlays over the exterior view.

-Fixed lampreys not hitting players and reduced their distance before attacking.

-Fixed a bug where ManOWar sounds bypassed the SFX volume settings.

-Fixed shop cases only being able to be paid out by the host.

-Made access to Discord Rich Presence DLLs safer and improved exception handling.

notes.title: The Civilized Update (0.7.2) - Civilizations are here!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/e909fc11e50e03ba98f58fb3c857f848084be5b6.png

Get your handshaking grip ready for the Civilized Update! This update marks our first full year on early access, so we’ve been working our butts off to deliver you one of our biggest features yet!

Civilizations !

The living infinite just got a lot more populated, with every biome now featuring its own fully fleshed-out civilizations!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d2588633f75ce216494b7d9214657c1789629ce0.png

You can find the home of these many societies on your journeys and park there like you would a cave. Explore, talk to the many citizens, spend your hard-earned gold on supplies, upgrades, or even a new crew member to join you on your adventure.

But, on your journey into the lands of these various undersea cultures, you may notice that that the language these undersea denizens use is quite unfamiliar…

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/162cb4a3fe27d1a4c787270287f6aba313b02119.png

New Item: The Translation Book!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/94383b0999c67fd660080f598a8356cd5ac0fd40.png

This handy new guide to all of the new undersea languages you’ll be discovering will be your key to understanding your friendly neighborhood fish friends. Meant for adventurers with a taste for curiosity and uncovering the stories the living infinite has the offer, the Translation Book will make a diplomat out of you yet!

Bonus feature: this bad boy makes you look like a genius - even if you read it upside-down.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/06fd3674df4e906d3358b498ea380793a5a85d56.png

Recruitable Creatures!

Found only at participating civilization locations, these eight unique NPCs can be recruited to help you on your travels! With each creature being unique to that civilization, you now have a wider variety of options to even the odds for the dangers that lie ahead.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/9e06e1e425920a9a6b6198975d4cd3e6c19e29f5.png

Merchants!

Depend no more purely on lady luck to net you the upgrades you need! Track down the local merchant of any civilization to browse their wares and pool together your uncovered gold to buy the items you need fair and square! Of course you COULD Just take what you want instead with the five finger discount, but be warned that the locals don’t take kindly to thieves…

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/4c9a0d574b8e8fc9820101a31c14fb4a3f6e48c1.png

In fact, the citizens of these undersea cities are more than capable of chasing players into their own submersible to make them pay for their transgressions...

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/dce0c1b531f05e83b3f0346d4402180ec53e4910.png

Bug fixes
-Leaderboards have been reset to give players a fair shake with all the new features
-Parallax fish no longer swim above the water line
-Bots no longer attack enemies unless they are aggroed
-Bots no longer fire at gore
-Bots continue aiming when the host is typing a message
-Bots are less likely to become stuck after leaving a cave due to a null reference
-Fixed medic bots not healing players in caves
-Reduced main scene load times, increasing rate of success for joining a server

Balance
-Barnacle Maw health has been reduced
-Pirate invaders have less health on average

Community Highlights
- http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1672393571646202909 
- http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1672392937614154340
- http://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/3270044456093598498
- https://steamcommunity.com/games/307110/announcements/detail/1600332806240922610

Player of the Month
This update's Player of the Month is Freemankiller! Freemankiller has provided us with valuable feedback almost since launch a year ago. His ability to find exploits and present them to us has been a huge tool for improvement. But his choice for this month comes from his ever-present bombastic participation in the community contests held in January! As with all Player of the Month winners, he'll receive four extra copies of Deeper to give to friends!

As a fair warning, given the sheer size of this update, we almost certainly have some new bugs hiding, waiting to strike, that will need help tracking down as they come up. But we’re very optimistic and very excited to bring you guys this update after a whole year on early access! As always keep sending us your feedback and your reports as they come up, and we'll continue to try and make We Need To Go Deeper the best it can be! Happy handshaking!

notes.title: The Squishy Update (0.7.0) - New Biome & Winter Event!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/dfb6228651bf2c4b42e4fdc06d9038f7ea8d1fd1.png

Get malleable with The Squishy Update! Introducing a brand new biome to explore, the start of our Winter Event, and more! 

Features

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2bdb05ba8d9e18af18284d1bfe8bc4d487841175.png

New Biome: The Aurelian Depths! - Introducing the Aurelian Depths; a bioluminescent third-layer biome where strange crystal minerals grow  in every crevice, and where jellyfish of all kinds bloom in the viscous pink waters.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/01f27a0deea8d183d52b53d0718450c8624c5bed.gif

 9 NEW Enemy Types! - From power-disrupting jellyfish to rock-burrowing worms, the Aurelian Depths is host to a wide variety of strange and dangerous new wildlife to discover.
 NEW Boss - The Ephyra! - A massive new boss awaits your crew at the bottom of the Aurelian Depths, filled to the brim with electric power...
NEW Mysterious Water Effects - There's something strange about the water down here. Some say a person could breathe it as if it were air.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0ba5615bb363a685992174a39d8afe50bc63ffb7.png

Bot Replacement Crates! - No longer will your team have to fret when a crew member drops out early, for they will be swiftly replaced via our Bot Crate Delivery system! A crate containing a handy Bot will appear in their place, awaiting to be broken open and freed with a good smack.

Winter Event

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/45bfa6bba0db21c7c241d22939f0486cb1473520.png

The Winter Event is Live!
5 Special Cosmetics!
 Gifting Sugarplum Fairies!
 Rabid Rat Foes!
Tis the season for giving, and no one likes giving more than the mysterious and most-likely-a-figment-of-your-imagination Sugarplum Fairies, who have taken it upon themselves to visit people around the world bearing Gifts!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/19f64a0a3d027f6e11626726042c25d966f90e36.png

Be wary before opening these Gifts, however. While some Gifts contain great wealth or even one of the legendary Nutcracker Heads, some contain filthy, ravenous Rats to punish the naughty.

The Sugarplum Fairies will vanish back into humans' collective imagination January 4th.

Bug Fixes
-Fixed a bug causing bots to get stuck in caves after being revived
-Fixed a bug where the main power console could "zap" indefinitely after an EMP
-Fixed null references in alert arrow following behavior causing mild slowdowns
-Fixed a bug causing midgame joining players to have invisible walls inside their caves
-Fixed bugs which could cause midgame joining to function poorly on repeat tries

Balance
-Barnacle grabber now has 20% less health
-Players holding a battery will drop it on death
-Players can now click to throw the battery they're holding
-Alerts for help from other players now only appear for 10 seconds

Community
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/927044661864141545/4556B287B560B183D664B801A58A6D9AF7B6E395/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside%7C1024%3A* Coming to us from amechami, a reminder of the danger posed by throwing insults.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png

::: Player of the Month ::::

December's Player of the Month is none other than our friendly neighborhood mod, ChildishRambino!

ChildishRambino has been around since the early days, going as far back as the April Update, and has been an avid supporter and community leader ever since. Between his countless efforts to spread the game to everyone and anyone, by talking about it with various streamers and content creators, and his great sense of humor and always-friendly demeanor, ChildishRambino has done more than enough to earn his title as Player of the Month, and we're only sorry it took this long to give him the recognition he deserves.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Update Announcement: January

Now would be a good time to go ahead and explain our plans to everyone regarding January's Update. Namely, that there will be no official Update in January, but instead, several Community Competitions to kick off the new year!

We're doing this for a few reasons:

1. Having no update in January will give us the extra time we need/desire to help make our Anniversary Update (Feb. 8th will mark a year since launch) the best it can possibly be! We have big plans for February's update, and we would love for it to go as smoothly as possible.

2. We've been on a roughly 2-week update schedule (counting events, crate updates, etc.) for almost a year now, and while the experience has been amazing, our small dev team could use some time to relax with family for the holidays before jumping back into a full schedule.

On that note, if you guys have any ideas for what kinds of community-driven competitions, challenges, or contests you'd like to see, let us know in the comments or forums!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Update Announcement: January

Now would be a good time to go ahead and explain our plans to everyone regarding January's Update. Namely, that there will be no official Update in January, but instead, several Community Competitions to kick off the new year!

We're doing this for a few reasons:

1. Having no update in January will give us the extra time we need/desire to help make our Anniversary Update (Feb. 8th will mark a year since launch) the best it can possibly be! We have big plans for February's update, and we would love for it to go as smoothly as possible.

2. We've been on a roughly 2-week update schedule (counting events, crate updates, etc.) for almost a year now, and while the experience has been amazing, our small dev team could use some time to relax with family for the holidays before jumping back into a full schedule.

On that note, if you guys have any ideas for what kinds of community-driven competitions, challenges, or contests you'd like to see, let us know in the comments or forums!

notes.title: December Update Sneaky Peaky
notes.notes:
Hey y'all! Nick from Deli Interactive here, and as you may have noticed, this month's update got delayed... With good reason, however! This next update is introducing a brand new BIOME, and will be accompanied by our Winter Event! While we don't have a beta ready yet, in the interest of not keeping y'all in the dark, here's a few previews of some of the new content we're working on:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/3f6d3b347b048c459d5f0c3b38f8b4cd3df293c5.png

This early photoshop mockup of the new biome, The Aurelian Depths, showcases the vivid, otherworldy atmosphere we are aiming for in this jellyfish-centric biome. Hard crystals and rock-burrowing Sea Worms contrast the maternal vibes the rest of the area will be conveying. The biome has changed a lot since this mockup, but it still conveys the overall sense of what you'll be seeing in this biome.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/93bcdaa97f551375b74e383764030cf0915d7781.gif
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/1210f3dee9e15be9ab46e897dffc31ed59b54427.gif

These two are a few of the new enemies you will encounter in the new jellyfish-laden biome. One of these fellas will be able to regenerate limbs once detached from the sub, and the other packs a powerful electric blast that can knock your power right out!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/04f0d6b3b968c06203c8a7485b0c57f56543914f.png

Last but not least, you can get a taste of the otherworldy atmosphere for the Aurelian Depths via its completed music track, composed by Jake Lives!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Sorry once again for the delay, but we're very excited for the new mechanics and gameplay possibilities this biome will bring to Deeper, so we appreciate your patience with us in the interest of making sure it's the best it can be! As always, continue leaving your feedback and reports, so we can keep trying to improve We Need To Go Deeper!

notes.title: Crate Update #6 - The Grease Crate (0.6.7)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/40fcd19f35ab10f02e76c91e7aeda84e2fccdeca.png

Get greasy with this month's Crate Update! New Bots and improvements, along with a sprinkling of other fixes are all wrapped up in this nuts and bolts package!

Features

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/432dc14f496bc34c84fcdd765280ce090977b2e4.png

New Bot Types! - You asked for it, so we added a new Bot Selection feature to let you pick Bots with different specialties to bring on your adventures! Introducing the rough-and-ready Fight Bots and the hippocratic oath-ing Med Bots!

To choose a bot type, select the Bot portrait after adding a Bot in a lobby to bring up the Bot Selection Menu, and diversify away!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7637df022812faeee04f8705df79f5360450fdc8.png

64 Bit Performance Boost! - Those with 64 bit operating systems are in for a treat, because they just got a big ol' performance boost with this update thanks to some good old fashioned compiling nonsense. It's hard to explain, but trust us, the game is a little faster now for y'all living in the 64 bit future world.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/22032ecbad925b4851e1c070f12b1bde208b9e94.png

Steam Friend Invites! Last but not least, you can now invite your Steam friends into games directly using our high-tec "Invite" button in the game lobby! Ping your friends like it's the 90's and everyone has a pager. I never had one, but I hear they worked exactly like Steam Invites.

Fixes

- Fixed auto-disconnects caused by sub deletion.
- Fixed removal of spaces in Steam Lobby data causing long lobby creation times.
- Possibly fixed players disconnecting while on cannon causing it to be unusable or locking in other players.

---------------------------------------------------

Let us know what y'all think of the new update as always! And stay tuned these next few months, because we're finally starting to break free of the mandatory technical updates and can dive back into that sweet, sweet content we all like so much.

notes.title: The Sudden Arrival Update (0.6.6) | Mid-Game Joining, Discord Integration & More!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/34602cacecd2e94fd7e71159e894422e89ed4374.png

Prepare yourself, because November's Official Content Update is comin' in hot! Mid-Game Joining, new state-of-the-art Discord integration and more has arrived!

Features

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a07bd7215c5e699e67a140aa5d556c38db242978.png

Mid-Game Joining! - Thanks to the power of Time Travel (and countless coffee fueled network code nights for Jordan), players can finally join adventures in progress! Now you can warp into games guns-blazing, and rescue crews from their demise, or else host a public game yourself filled with a skeleton crew of Bots, to have them replaced by real players over the course of your adventure! Who needs to wait around in lobbies when you have swashbuckling Mid-Game Join action!?

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/09adbb1cbcb80bc0b62699ea12b4940da7a354d7.png

Note: If you'd rather not have players warping into your session, or else if you want Bots to be irreplaceable by mere mortal flesh, you can toggle both of these via Game Options in the Lobby. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/bac9c8deda35375dce854c7dd31b1cc9cc6e8fdc.png

Discord "Rich Presence" Integration! - The top secret labs over at Discord Head Quarters have been brewing up a brand new way to join games with friends, and we've been along for the ride! 

Discord's newest feature is called "Rich Presence" - and We Need To Go Deeper is on board!

https://discordapp.com/rich-presence

With Rich Presence, your Discord friends can see what you are up to in-game, displaying everything from what Biome you are currently traversing, to what submarine you are driving! More importantly, they can see how big your crew is, so they'll know the perfect time to warp into your game! We Need To Go Deeper is among the first group of games to integrate with Discord in such a way, so now you too can feel like you're getting in on some real ground-floor gaming science.

Also - The We Need To Go Deeper Discord is now Verified! So if you haven't already, join the Official WNTGD Discord community and get in on the sweet, sweet, science action.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/fa22cba575c45bda859a10604e11e529fb0b78e3.png

New Relics! - The Living Infinite spills its secrets once more with brand new Relics to uncover in every biome. Each one is chock full of juicy hints regarding The Living Infinite's mysterious history and cultures, so bust out your shovels and start digging... for knowledge.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/c40f8ed8b23916db0d8360cdc716c4c849f2823c.png

Tips! - You'll notice when diving into another adventure that some helpful new in-game tips will occasionally pop up to remind you how to engage with the world! These tips are here to help new and returning players learn how to get into the swing of things! Veteran swashbucklers who would rather not see these tips can also turn them off at will via the Options Menu.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7b250b8e954dad6ae7c1e34e7d7c1e5c3c1c79aa.png

Command Wheel as Quick Chat! - The Command Wheel (Middle Mouse by Default) has been equipped with brand new functionality! Now not only can you use the command wheel to order around loyal Bots, but you can order around your human crew as well! At the touch of a button, send snap messages to your team about your need to heal, assistance with torpedoes (which Bots are also now capable of), or just tell them they're doing a [strike]great[/strike] terrible job! 

Additionally, the Command Wheel is no longer exclusive to the Host! Joining players can shout at their team and bots as well as anyone.

Bug Fixes

- Fixed Bots not being able to navigate past frozen/vined up doors. Bots will now destroy door obstacles when needed.
- Fixed Bots occasionally getting stuck in submarine hatches.
- Fixed player count displaying incorrectly on LAN games.
- Online games should (hopefully) no longer be able to exceed max player limits.
- Fixed custom game option player health not being applied to clients correctly.
- Fixed loadout confirmation being dependent on other players.

Community Highlights

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png

::: Player of the Month :::

November's Player of the Month award goes to... därSeebär!

This one has been a long time coming, because while Steam user därSeebär has only recently jumped back into the community proper after a period of absence (a friendly reminder that real life should always take priority over games of course), it's hard to overstate just how helpful this dude is whenever he has been present. därSeebär has taken an incredibly professional and leader-like approach to everything he's done in the WNTGD community, from creating helpful templates and guides to smooth the process of editing the WNTGD Wiki, to jump-starting the creation of an official group for diligent Wiki editors, and on top of that taking on Mod duties within the WNTGD Discord and Steam Forums. This guy's been ever-helpful and supportive since day one, and showcases an admirable sense of professionalism in everything he does. Thank you, därSeebär!

As always, the Player of the Month will be sent 4 copies of WNTGD to send to friends and family as a reward for their efforts.

::: Community Showcase :::

First up on the showcase is this incredible Halloween costume of Pale Jaw, sent to us by fan Eve Moran. We were blown away by this creation, and the attention to detail (Pale Jaw seen here munching on a small model of The Crevette) really puts the [strike]cherry[/strike] candy corn on top. Thanks Eve!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ce5ce480d0f70734057f383ec619edc673997da.jpg

Speaking of costumes, we also received via email these great hand-made costume suggestions for WNTG characters by fans OnkelTino and bubuassnibba! The french artist is by far my favorite of the bunch here. We may yet see some of these become a reality yet.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d520273e78a00ec92c51d38daede631abcce5833.png

Meanwhile, resident goat enthusiast Gote The Capricorn Trickster has been brewing up these cute and fun fan designs for a "Land Shark" pet, this one being my favorite:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1146830392

In  less cute news, Wrzlprnft seems to be performing some kind of black magic ritual with the Dev team lately. Here's hoping we'll survive whatever hexes he's got planned.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1163802814

For those looking for a laugh, ZeroScotty brewed up a new video recently detailing their crew's first experience with some particularly rude Bots, fashioned and edited into a few choice highlights from their adventure:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1175610956

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, let us know what you guys think of the new update, and be sure and leave your thoughts in the forums! Happy diving, y'all!

notes.title: The "I Need To Go Deeper" Update (0.6.5) | Crew Bots & Fall Event live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/51766fbae93255dc2d2b3096e05999c487e6bc18.png

https://youtu.be/yuWfGz4w3wQ
Grease those joints up for the official October content update! The Incredible Gear-Driven Gentlemen and Wind-Up Women are here, along with the New Fall Event!

Features

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7ba47ab317754170021c02d7242202925daf6aba.png

Crew Bots! The most handy and helpful Crew Bots are here! Fresh off the Assembly Line, these approximations of human crew members can help fix, defend, and help you on your feet during future expeditions! They've even been programmed to have unique personalities, so it's like you never left home! (Disclaimer: Not a cure for homesickness.)

Here is a full list of the amazing things your brand new Crew Bots can do: 

 Repair Vessels!
 Defend Against Invading Foes!
 Man the Weapons!
 Change Power on Command!
 Revive Fallen Comrades!
 Explore Caverns!
 Future Functions Pending!

While Crew Bots are able to make their own decisions (most of the time), you can command your bots to do any of these tasks yourself by utilizing the amazing Command Wheel! (Middle Mouse by Default)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/462b2238e09b8240a6c9538e5baa8a7e5d767c0f.png

To add Bots to your next adventure, either Online or Offline, just fill a player slot with these handy Bot-Buttons!™

Fall Event

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/3514cf2ae3c0b0aa1cfc137b991fc6ad44d096e0.png

The Heads of the Horseman Fall Event is Live!

 5 New Unlockable Cosmetics!
 2 New Spooky Enemy Types!
 1 New Mini-Boss!

As the leaves descend from the trees, so too does the vengeful Headless Horseman rise from his resting place, donning atop his head twisted mutations of the season's harvest! Only problem is - The Horseman's Heads have disappeared! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0848eddad4b76b0a2844bc25e7df72663e3b37b7.png

Legends say The Horseman's accursed Produce began spreading their own evil seed among the populace, spawning devilish plantlife throughout the world - including the very depths themselves! The Living Infinite is the latest to be infested with this bountiful harvest of hallowed fruit - and The Horseman will hunt down anyone who dares get in his way of reclaiming these lost heads!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/9882ffb3cbacb74de221a1ae3f22973b9e98ab9a.png
Of course, there's always the possibility that someone will discover the lost Heads of the Horseman first, should they manage to overcome a plump pumpkiny fate. Even rarer are those that may come across and overcome The Horseman himself, and lay claim to his very own wardrobe!

Act quick, mortal adventurers, for The Horseman will return to his grave on November 10th.

Balance & Fixes

-Time Traveler will not appear after game over.
-Time Traveler slightly less likely to rescue crew from dire situations.
-Fixed a bug causing grabber and stabber type enemies to collide with the sub from inexplicable distances

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A huge thanks to all of the community members who helped us test out this update so we could iron out the kinks! There are surely still more kinks to iron out, but we couldn't have released this without y'all! Thanks again, and happy diving!

notes.title: The "I Need To Go Deeper" Update (0.6.5) | Crew Bots & Fall Event live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/51766fbae93255dc2d2b3096e05999c487e6bc18.png

https://youtu.be/yuWfGz4w3wQ
Grease those joints up for the official October content update! The Incredible Gear-Driven Gentlemen and Wind-Up Women are here, along with the New Fall Event!

Features

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7ba47ab317754170021c02d7242202925daf6aba.png

Crew Bots! The most handy and helpful Crew Bots are here! Fresh off the Assembly Line, these approximations of human crew members can help fix, defend, and help you on your feet during future expeditions! They've even been programmed to have unique personalities, so it's like you never left home! (Disclaimer: Not a cure for homesickness.)

Here is a full list of the amazing things your brand new Crew Bots can do: 

 Repair Vessels!
 Defend Against Invading Foes!
 Man the Weapons!
 Change Power on Command!
 Revive Fallen Comrades!
 Explore Caverns!
 Future Functions Pending!

While Crew Bots are able to make their own decisions (most of the time), you can command your bots to do any of these tasks yourself by utilizing the amazing Command Wheel! (Middle Mouse by Default)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/462b2238e09b8240a6c9538e5baa8a7e5d767c0f.png

To add Bots to your next adventure, either Online or Offline, just fill a player slot with these handy Bot-Buttons!™

Fall Event

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/3514cf2ae3c0b0aa1cfc137b991fc6ad44d096e0.png

The Heads of the Horseman Fall Event is Live!

 5 New Unlockable Cosmetics!
 2 New Spooky Enemy Types!
 1 New Mini-Boss!

As the leaves descend from the trees, so too does the vengeful Headless Horseman rise from his resting place, donning atop his head twisted mutations of the season's harvest! Only problem is - The Horseman's Heads have disappeared! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/0848eddad4b76b0a2844bc25e7df72663e3b37b7.png

Legends say The Horseman's accursed Produce began spreading their own evil seed among the populace, spawning devilish plantlife throughout the world - including the very depths themselves! The Living Infinite is the latest to be infested with this bountiful harvest of hallowed fruit - and The Horseman will hunt down anyone who dares get in his way of reclaiming these lost heads!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/9882ffb3cbacb74de221a1ae3f22973b9e98ab9a.png
Of course, there's always the possibility that someone will discover the lost Heads of the Horseman first, should they manage to overcome a plump pumpkiny fate. Even rarer are those that may come across and overcome The Horseman himself, and lay claim to his very own wardrobe!

Act quick, mortal adventurers, for The Horseman will return to his grave on November 10th.

Balance & Fixes

-Time Traveler will not appear after game over.
-Time Traveler slightly less likely to rescue crew from dire situations.
-Fixed a bug causing grabber and stabber type enemies to collide with the sub from inexplicable distances

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A huge thanks to all of the community members who helped us test out this update so we could iron out the kinks! There are surely still more kinks to iron out, but we couldn't have released this without y'all! Thanks again, and happy diving!

notes.title: Update 0.6.5 Has Been Delayed :(
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/94813596e34dec4a89a424adbb1564b4d2001a73.png

Sorry for the lateness of this announcement, as I'm sure many of you are wondering why today's scheduled Content Update did not go live. 

In short - we have a few more major kinks to work out of this new update, as it features some pretty crazy complicated new things - AI Helper Bots mainly - that as it turns out, could not be churned out with sufficient polish in a mere month's time. 

We'd rather delay than release something we know isn't ready to be played with yet, so unfortunately we're gonna have to take a little longer to kick these Bots into high gear, so to speak.

We had planned on releasing a Beta version of the build by the end of the day if it was functional enough, but here we are and that's not the case. Hopefully this week should see a release of a Beta version of this new update for y'all to test with so we can get these Bots into tip-top shape for the official release! 

As always, thank you all for your patience and continuous feedback! We try not to delay an update unless absolutely necessary, but we think you guys will appreciate the end result!

notes.title: Crate Update #5 - The Squishy Crate (0.6.3)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/594c0c9054094f4296be79aa70def10f9c426394.png

Unpack a whole lot of squishy, slimy monstrosity and good old fashioned balance changes in this month's Crate Update!

Features

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/459790383f54fa3e4d7f30e37aa28e4a9dc0b921.png

New Boss: The Quadken! - A new four-tentacled behemoth has arrived in the depths of The Atlantic Waters in the form of the squishy and monstrous Quadken! The Mother of all Duopi, The Quadken will do anything to protect her young from surface invaders, and with four powerful tentacles to shield her, daring adventurers will have to outmaneuver and outsmart this angry mother if they wish to venture past her sticky domain.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/47dfcd4a9e12a981e75aba1369f06a00f261a34d.gif

Swap-At-Will Sub Weapons! - After our many attempts to balance our previous iteration of the two-gun ammo system for the Weapon Station, we have once again altered the functionality of the Weapons Station as you know it! Now those at the Weapons Console will be able to swap shooting styles at will at the press of a button! By default, A and D will now swap the current gun being used by the Submarine, with Weapons Power being used instead to determine how much firing power you have available to you at any given time! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/39c62c1c478baf50df48cd1f146bc1d083f6f50c.png

Time Traveler Rescue! - When put into dire situations, The Time Traveler now has a chance to come to your rescue! Whether it be through dumping a load of Health Elixirs into the ship, warping your vessel out of a messy situation entirely, or restoring your vessel to its original unbroken state of being, The Time Traveler is here to help! Sometimes. More often now, anyway. 

Special Tip: The Time Traveler is even more likely to help now with some encouragement.

Balance

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/70c7d6af9e13403fd4a109ee619286b875410e82.png

Balance-palooza! Balancing out some of our new features and long-standing issues has been a major priority of this update! In fact, the last two features listed above are in themselves also features of this balance shift. Now for the rest of the Balance-palooza:

-The EMP no longer uses fuel! Instead, it recharges over the course of a minute, and has helpful light indicators to show it recharging! Use unlimited times!
-The base EMP damage has been increased
-The machine gun now fires slower at one power and faster at two power than the previous update's values.
-The time traveler is now especially fond of the phonograph. Perhaps keeping one around will encourage him to bring in nice things?
-The cheat checker should now actually shut down cheated games.
-The dynamic difficulty system is now willing to give much longer rests to crews who turn the engines off
-Rests caused by extended combat time are now longer on average

Fixes
-Solid rocks using polygon colliders! Tired of the sub flying into the rocks and getting stuck forever? Tired of enemies doing the same thing? We were too. 
-Fixed several cave chunks which had impossible ladders or would yield a path that couldn't be traversed by players
-Fixed a bug that was causing "custom game" parameter to be sticky and incorrectly flag a game as custom (preventing saving of newly found items)
-Fixed some bad logic on doors causing them too close early or not stay open for players

Other
-The exterior camera is now more zoomed out during boss fights so you can see those sweet sweet Quadken animations.
