notes.title: The Timely Update (0.6.2) - Time Traveler, Trading Cards and More!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/cb2e9570c775258be5090e1c3388e9a127e0a194.png

Get warped in September's official content update! This month we have a feast for your eyes and ears, and a very special visitor will be making his presence known in the world of We Need To Go Deeper - The unknowable Time Traveler!

Content

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f8c84236dec93c8c798afcd408dcc2e9fb50e713.png

Time Traveler Events! - The enigmatic, inscrutable Time Traveler has started warping inside the vessels of ongoing expeditions, and may cause all kinds of michief and mayhem, including:

Time Travel "Souvenirs!" - The Traveler often brings with him "souvenirs" from his travels to leave behind in your vessel, of both the dangerous and helpful variety. Will The Traveler leave behind one of 14 New Unique Enemies from all reaches of time and space? Or will he leave your crew a helpful upgrade, item, or elixir? Only TIME will tell!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/fb98a1c3282de49851f54aaa2ac40d56136e9a9f.gif

Alternate Timelines! Sometimes, The Traveler may deem it necessary to warp your crew to a different timeline altogether! Timelines can be unstable, so be on your toes when you find yourself in unexpected places!

Mysterious Messages! Finally, keep an ear out for what The Traveler has to say when he passes by, because sometimes he'll have special messages to share that may hint at The Living Infinite's deepest secrets...

The Time Traveler may yet have more tricks up his sleeve in the future, so keep your eyes peeled!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/773f0ca64a58dd8a994467ff235d1587dcb67621.png

Steam Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons and Backgrounds! - By popular demand, The Steam Trading Card system has now come to We Need To Go Deeper! Featuring original, hand-drawn 19th century style card art to represent all of the classic WNTGD player roles, 9 different possible WNTGD-themed emoticons to unlock, 3 uniqe Steam backgrounds based off WNTGD's darkest biomes, and of course, shiny port-hole badges to show off your Deeper dedication!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/4b96a99cd120654b938d41b8887f097084c8da0a.png

Official Soundtrack Now Available for FREE! - Even though the game is still in development, many of you have been asking us time and time again when we'd be able to make available all of the tracks we have thus far. Starting today, we've released and will continue to release all of the game's tracks for FREE on Soundcloud! Kick back and relax to the sweet sounds of "The Marvelous Music of We Need To Go Deeper."

  Additionally, be sure to check out our Bonus Album, "Buried Treasure" - full of all of our unused/demo tracks!


Bug Fixes
-Found and fixed a problem in identifying weapons in hand over the network which was causing packet buildup and desync
-Fixed a potential off-by-one network identity numbering bug caused by a prefab with two network identities
-Optimized interior enemy collision/trigger checking
-Fixed two more sources of move speed bugs
-Fixed a scaling problem on puke piles (seriously, how do these guys keep coming up with problems?)
-Dynamite can no longer repair breaks - yes, even if you aim it really well. 
-Fixed a problem getting fish school sprites after changing water layer
-Fixed the bug causing permanent disarming if a player is thrown in the brig while carrying a torpedo or battery
-Fixed a problem where networked position syncing failed to account for gravity scale
-Made one more failsafe for a rare bug where an exterior enemy spawns directly after entering a cave, which cannot be killed

Balance
-Fuel drop chance in caves increased 10%
-Battery drop chance in caves increased 13%
-Increased time between spawns on all hatcher type enemies

Other
-The Espadon now costs 5000 less gold in the catalog
-Chat messages now stay onscreen twice as long

Community

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png

::: Player of the Month :::

August's Player of the Month is... Pigeon Man!

Pigeon Man has been a huge help in the community, particularly on the forums. They've taken the time not only to give feedback and suggestions but can also often be found troubleshooting and helping others through bugs and problems. He's constantly offering to test with us and has sent many log files that have helped us identify some tough bugs! Pigeon Man approaches everyone with kindness and a great sense of humor; it's always clear that they're dedicated simply to helping us out, for which we are very grateful.

As usual, our Player of the Month Pigeon Man will be sent 4 copies of WNTGD as a reward for their efforts. 

::: Community Content :::

This month Steam user ADcrafter started spinning a new tale of a Living Infinite expedition in the newfound Lore & Stories subforum! You can read the first two parts of his new sea tale here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/4/1473096694438404786/

-----------------------------------------------------------

Thank you to everyone for supporting us as always, and let us know what you think of the update! Happy TRAVELS, y'all!

notes.title: Crate Update #4 - The Ramming Crate (0.6.0)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/713445d0319578319a1fd1cd3a0cbaadfb061264.png

This month's Crate Update is all about quality over quantity. There's not much packed in this crate, but what is here sure does fill a whole lotta space! A new Submarine, Network fixes and more await those who dare unpack The Ramming Crate!

Features

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f51547bcc5656ccf9d98e93f53bb70c5a7c34d95.png
New purchasable submarine with a RAAAAAAAMMMMMMM! IT GO BAAAAAAMMMMM!

That's right, a new Submarine has entered the mix, but this time, you better save up your bottom dollar for it! Introducing The Espadon a brand-new vessel equipped with a large sharp nose, made for piercing foes, and charging through obstacles like nobody's business! It's the fastest sub in the game so far, though speed comes at a price, for there are no shields equipped on this bad boy, so you better make good use of your offensive capabilities.

Fixes
-FINALLY fixed permanent movement impairing effects. 
-Entirely new low-bandwidth smooth position syncing for players, interior enemies, and some exterior hazards
-Excess spawn points in caves now spawn more decorations - caves should look ever so slightly more lively
-Fixed a problem with connection logging that was giving us weird impossible data when we looked at connection success rates
-Fixed bubbles and other particle emitters which were throwing errors after scenes had changed
-Fixed yet another problem that was causing the Blobfish not to leave puke all over the sub. Now he will. You're welcome.
-Fixed a problem where the barnacle swiper could damage the sub multiple times in a row

Balance
-The amount of gold per pile has been reduced to accommodate the higher treasure drop rate from the last update
-Fuel drop rate similarly decreased in caves to accommodate the higher treasure drop rate


Community

Some really awesome Community Content was brought to light to us this week thanks to Youtuber Draegast's coverage of some Deeper-flavored fan-made creations in Besiege! 

Both of these Besiege creations by Censored Studios are beautifully designed recreations of certain aspects of WNTGD! One is a fully-fleshed out Crevette Vessel, complete with all its interior bits and bobs, and the other is a fully-featured mini-game complete with submarine piloting, exploring, shooting swimming enemies and fighting a boss at the end of a trench! If you're a Besiege owner you can download the mods below, and gameplay can be seen in the Draegast video linked below that!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1081946252

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1110464522

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JTierlohU9U&feature=youtu.be&t=5m41sid=1110464522&searchtext=deeper

----------------------------------------------------------------

Let us know what you think of the update as always! Happy diving!

----------------------------------------------------------------

Stealth fixes (post-update patched items):
-Fixed a move speed bug which was causing players to speed off in negative directions
-Torpedoes no longer explode on contact with the Espadon ram
-Ram damage is much more proportional to the speed of the crash
-Ram now damages ice chunks properly, and deals more damage to ice chunks on average than enemies
-Updated Unity to 5.6.3, which alleges more networking stability fixes, especially with the specialized connection types and channels we use for Deeper (see all fixes marked "Multiplayer" in https://unity3d.com/unity/whats-new/unity-5.6.3)
-Torpedo damage has been redistributed. A direct hit yields 6 damage, whereas area of effect damage yields 5 damage (adjusted from the previous 10 for direct hit and 1 for area of effect)
-Increased Perle submarine speed 10% for all power levels
-Reduced max cave enemy count by 17%
-Reduced "hatcher" enemy type frequency by ~15%, depending on biome
-Fixed a couple of obvious graphical mishaps in the Espadon interior

That's right, a new Submarine has entered the mix, but this time, you better save up your bottom dollar for it! Introducing The Espadon a brand-new vessel equipped with a large sharp nose, made for piercing foes, and charging through obstacles like nobody's business! It's the fastest sub in the game so far, though speed comes at a price, for there are no shields equipped on this bad boy, so you better make good use of your offensive capabilities.

Fixes
-FINALLY fixed permanent movement impairing effects. 
-Entirely new low-bandwidth smooth position syncing for players, interior enemies, and some exterior hazards
-Excess spawn points in caves now spawn more decorations - caves should look ever so slightly more lively
-Fixed a problem with connection logging that was giving us weird impossible data when we looked at connection success rates
-Fixed bubbles and other particle emitters which were throwing errors after scenes had changed
-Fixed yet another problem that was causing the Blobfish not to leave puke all over the sub. Now he will. You're welcome.
-Fixed a problem where the barnacle swiper could damage the sub multiple times in a row

Balance
-The amount of gold per pile has been reduced to accommodate the higher treasure drop rate from the last update
-Fuel drop rate similarly decreased in caves to accommodate the higher treasure drop rate


Community

Some really awesome Community Content was brought to light to us this week thanks to Youtuber Draegast's coverage of some Deeper-flavored fan-made creations in Besiege! 

Both of these Besiege creations by Censored Studios are beautifully designed recreations of certain aspects of WNTGD! One is a fully-fleshed out Crevette Vessel, complete with all its interior bits and bobs, and the other is a fully-featured mini-game complete with submarine piloting, exploring, shooting swimming enemies and fighting a boss at the end of a trench! If you're a Besiege owner you can download the mods below, and gameplay can be seen in the Draegast video linked below that!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1081946252

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1110464522

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JTierlohU9U&feature=youtu.be&t=5m41sid=1110464522&searchtext=deeper

----------------------------------------------------------------

Let us know what you think of the update as always! Happy diving!

----------------------------------------------------------------

Stealth fixes (post-update patched items):
-Fixed a move speed bug which was causing players to speed off in negative directions
-Torpedoes no longer explode on contact with the Espadon ram
-Ram damage is much more proportional to the speed of the crash
-Ram now damages ice chunks properly, and deals more damage to ice chunks on average than enemies
-Updated Unity to 5.6.3, which alleges more networking stability fixes, especially with the specialized connection types and channels we use for Deeper (see all fixes marked "Multiplayer" in https://unity3d.com/unity/whats-new/unity-5.6.3)
-Torpedo damage has been redistributed. A direct hit yields 6 damage, whereas area of effect damage yields 5 damage (adjusted from the previous 10 for direct hit and 1 for area of effect)
-Increased Perle submarine speed 10% for all power levels
-Reduced max cave enemy count by 17%
-Reduced "hatcher" enemy type frequency by ~15%, depending on biome
-Fixed a couple of obvious graphical mishaps in the Espadon interior

notes.title: The Milking-It Update (0.5.9)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/77b46b357faaa5b73735f232389c7590a61e9a2b.png

Get your lactose on for August's official content update! After the feedback we got from last month's update, we've been doubling down this month on milking the most out of the game's features to increase replayability, moment-to-moment thrills, and addressing the community's most pressing desires and concerns from our recent balance changes! Grab a carton, and let's dive right in!

Features

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a6b749567ed0baab637c0a87fa14bbf54ba66fcb.gif
Above: Our Cave Generator at Work

Revamped Procedural Generation! - By far this month's biggest focus was giving our procedural generation systems a much-needed kick in the udder! Both of our exterior Trench and interior Cave algorithms got a well-deserved revamping - changes including but not limited to:

- Diversified Levels: Each level generator has had a sizable new sampling of level styles and layouts added to generate from, ensuring more diversity and unpredictability for future playthroughs! This includes new claustrophobic areas that require players to crouch through, and open platforming areas to leap through!

- Multi-layered Caves: Caves can now be generated in a variety of different sizes and layers, ranging from small crab hovels to sprawling multi-floored caverns with branching paths!

- Sub-biomes: While exploring the Trench, you may occasionally come across smaller colored sub-biomes, restricted to generating certain kinds of wildlife and obstacles, to further diversify your moment-to-moment explorations.

- Spawn grouping: Individual cave chunks are now able to better control their spawning habits, creating more interesting clusters of rewards and danger at a whim. No longer will everything always be spread out thinly like butter, but in clusters! Come across a horde of crabs one moment, and a treasure trove the next!



http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/54e1148c59b8c4762abaaea890299bbc81303bf3.png

Custom Game Options! - By far one of the most commonly requested features, Custom Game Options are finally here! No longer will your games be at the developers' mercy, for these first four option sliders (more to come) will allow you to customize just how challenging you want your adventure to be! Play your way!

The Custom Game Options are available to be enabled by the Host when in a game Lobby. WARNING: For balance reasons, Leaderboards and item unlocking are disabled when Custom Game Options are enabled.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/75bf3b62901f483903f05396612944b640ac079c.png

Back-End Data Gathering! - While it may not be flashy, our newest build now has the ability to send the developers relevant in-game data so we can better track in-game events for important information! This data includes things like Connection Success Rates, Disconnects, Game Length, and so on! 

With this juicy new information, we'll be able to better track and prioritize network stability and game balance across our whole userbase, and not just the vocal minority. As much as we appreciate having such an active community, this is the best way we figure we can ensure the game is still in a good place for our less-vocal players. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/41b47e9f9687f17e6cc3913f5aefb07415f18738.png

New Spawner Enemy Type! - A new class of enemies has started to appear in select biomes of The Living Infinite - the relentless Spawners! From hatching Egg piles in the Arctic, to miniature crawling Hives in the Infected Depths, Spawners will ensure that those who dare venture alone will have their work cut out for them...

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/567d4ac5488f9e92fbfedc3a7d7943c7531ee684.png

New Relics to Discover! - Just what it says on the tin! A heaping helping of lore-filled relics have been added to The Living Infinite to be discovered, some of which will even help illuminate some of our future content...

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/c0d37e15631f8f76ec0e88b844d8f9f574312978.png

Revamped Fuel Mechanics! - Last month's Fuel mechanic was quite the divisive one among our players; with some folks appreciating the new challenge that came with managing a new resource, while others felt like it was more of an annoyance. After reading a ton of your guys' feedback and deliberating, we think we may have hit the sweet spot with the mechanic!

Now no longer does Fuel automatically get spent when the engines are turned up, but instead, only gets used when the Driver wants to put the pedal to the metal, so to speak. (Or when firing an EMP)

When driving, you can BOOST using Fuel by holding down the Fire Button (Spacebar by default). 

We think this new implementation makes the use of fuel much more deliberate, and honestly all-around more fun! We hope y'all will agree when you start using it yourselves!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/71cc3a2d41f83b8c562b53b4b8aba11e8f5d8961.png

Milky Cosmetics! - Last but not least, a few new cosmetics were added in honor of this month's update! Get your farmer tan on with the new Farmer Attire and Farm Hat, or Graze and Dive with the Bessie Mask!

Bug Fixes/Improvements
-A serious relay connection issue was found and fixed. The relays should now be correctly picking up the slack when other connection types fail (read: better connection success rates)
-Unity updated to 5.6, giving us the far improved new network transport system. This should dramatically reduce disconnects caused by packet buffering (read: more stable in-game connections).
-Updated our connection tool to get the latest fixes in Open NAT/UPNP functionality (read: better connection success rates)
-Updated our punchthrough facilitator to match the new connection tool update, which should increase punchthrough rates (read: better connection success rates)
-Cave enemies' target detection code has been greatly optimized and now does much fewer raycasts and no longer uses search functions to find players
-Fixed a bug where barrels were spawning their loot into the ground
-Updated Steamworks .NET plugin, which should reduce "Steam integration not initialized" errors
-Cheat checker should no longer be incorrectly flagging players as cheating (as always, if it does incorrectly flag you, please let us know on the forums so we can track down any edge cases)
-Fixed the loud time traveler sounds when the game is about to loop

Balance
-All base submarine speeds without fuel use have been increased
-Fuel consumption rate is now higher to accommodate for higher base speeds and boosting being optional
-Level length per water layer decreased by 20%
-Maximum caves per water layer decreased by 33% to match the lower level length and huge cave possiblities
-The camera following the sub now zooms in when the sub moves faster to help more careful shooting at low speeds and more hilarious crashes at high speeds.
-Cave enemy count now scales with player count

Other
-You can now rebind the driving and cannon rotation controls in the options menu (useful if you want to un-invert them!)
-All voice/text chat can be enabled or disabled in the options menu
-Removed the old IPv6 warning from the Play menu
-Added a new warning in the Play menu to tell players if they have a VPN network adapter turned on (this causes joining online to fail most of the time)

Community Highlights

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png

::: Player of the Month :::

July's Player of the Month is... ADcrafter!

ADcrafter has been one of our most active community members since they first jumped into the game, and have been a great help in keeping the spirit alive during this busy month for us, where we were unable to deliver either an in-game event or a Crate Update to help with the mid-month lulls. ADcrafter has, in the meantime, been collaborating with other users on fan works, giving constant feedback/suggestions in the forums, and has been helping others troubleshoot their problems, including walking folks through on how to send us output logs (a great deal of the logs we have gotten this month came through thanks to ADcrafter's help, and have helped illuminate some new issues some of our newer players are experiencing!) Between ADcrafter's persistence, kindness, and creativity, ADcrafter has done more than enough to deserve this month's Player of the Month award.

As usual, our Player of the Month ADcrafter will be sent 4 copies of WNTGD as a reward for their efforts. 

::: Community Content Highlight :::

There's been a lot of cool Deeper-related fan content this month, that I'm not even sure where to begin! 

First up is this freakin' awesome 3D model of WNTGD's Tesla Gun, posted in the Official Discord by Discord user Silver0034. Its accuracy is top-notch and I want a printed model of this thing for my desk like, yesterday.

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/319482214222004234/336904435194134539/unknown.png

Next up, "Lazy Robo" - a fan art piece by Steam user Legend of Jordy, depicting a We Need To Go Deeper styled automoton resting it up on the shore, drinking a nice cool glass of Fuel. This piece is both incredibly charming and quite faithful to the game's style! 

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1076637389

Next we have this lovely instructional video by Steam user Eok.Zero on how to properly use We Need To Go Deeper's Brig system - for griefing your friends. ːsteamhappyː

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=975346732

Next, this screenshot of an expertly synchronized team death by Steam user yuda0907 is oddly satisfying:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1082094487

... While Steam user Solger Barky-Sharky's snapshot of their crew's encounter with two giant boarding Boars is a pretty gnarly shot in its own right.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1080479651

Finally, we have a few highlights from the Steam Forums as well - with Steam user JJXDoge having recently put together an impressive Crevette submarine in Minecraft:

http://imgur.com/a/LWbu7

...and Steam users ADCrafter and Freemankiller at it with some more excellent collaborative fan fiction - this time with some additional classic literature influences thrown in for good measure!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/0/1456202492186289176/

------------------------------------------------

As always, let us know what you think of the new update, and thanks for continuing to help us keep the WNTGD community strong and growing! We're 6 months out from when we first launched on Early Access now - and still going strong! In a large part thanks to all of y'all and your support! Keep helping us spread the word as always, and happy diving! :D

------------------------------------------------

Hotfixed changes since update:
-Fixed snail spawner type enemy producing way too many snails
-Fixed the cheat checker flagging catalog purchases as cheating (whoops!)
-Changed spawn distribution/number of enemies in caves to reduce "bald spots" where cave chunks contain nothing and prevent crazy overpopulated caves
-Fixed cave music not playing upon entering a cave
-Balanced EMP to no longer bias enemy spawning against the sub (fuel is the new cost)
-Fixed a painting in the Perle appearing behind a girder
-Slightly optimized cave spine destruction

notes.title: The Splurge & Surge Update (0.5.8) | New Sub, Voice Chat, and More!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6499939d8372698148b82cb12e80229bf3e9b3f8.png

Fuel up for July's content update! This month we're bringing the JUICE. Whether that be of the boosting, vocal, or electric variety. Complete with a new electrically charged 2-crew vessel, integrated voice chat, and more. Read on to find out what's in store!

Content

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2b21644a4b4616ed3e7b021396245e6fde06fc79.png

New Vessel: The Perle! - This compact little fella puts everything you need in between one big ladder and a whole lotta power, making it perfectly suited for bite-sized crews. It may be small, but what it lacks in speed and armor it makes up for in electric boogaloo. The Perle comes equipped with upgraded shields and a harder-hitting EMP, making this a safe option for first-timers.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/17b9599ac7ee071254bf08e60802dd9af00b396a.png

Native Voice Chat! - Shout at your crew like never before with our newly integrated native voice chat! At the press of a button (V by default) you too can bark orders or tell sea shanties and whales of tales to your fellow sea dogs. For those who prefer peace and quiet, you can also mute those sailor mouths with the use of the Player Info Window (Tab by default)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/1bb5e9629dea4241c9f2e51677ec17790ac69231.png

Fuel! - Introducing a new resource into the Deeper world - Fuel! The formerly electric vessels are now hybrids, with Fuel allowing you to cruise at your higher Engine speeds and powering your powerful EMP shots. Spend fuel wisely, though - if you run out you'll be operating on pure electric power, capping your max get-away speed, and EMP's will no longer be operable. 

Have no fear however, for you will be able to refill your tank and even upgrade its capacity with Fuel Canisters and Upgrades you can find in caves!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/966ff75524626ebdae8131fb60e9b452ea8ed56a.png

A New Foe: The Purussaurus! - The Prehistoric biome just got a lot toothier with this new ancient Crocodile entering its turf. This snappy fella is hungry for adventurer meat, and he'll bust straight through metal to fetch his meal... 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d6f5b28d85c1efd57d16da53935cc9de05008b01.png

New Aquatic Life! - A wide variety of new fish species have appeared in The Living Infinite's various biomes. They don't bite, but they sure do make the place look nicer. Note: Please do not tap on glass.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f9e715e3362a087a992fd7bad0062a8fe387990d.png

New Special Cave Drop: The Battery! - This strange-looking electric capsule doesn't behave like most Vessel Upgrades you're used to - this fella needs to be picked up and plugged into a Power Console! Once plugged in, The Battery will constantly provide an external source of power to the console it's attached to, until it runs out of juice! Free up your energy costs and plug in a battery!
Note: bring a friend to watch your back when you are hauling a battery; these fellas are heavy and will take both your arms to lift!

Bug Fixes
-Fixed a bug where the host player could only use machine gun functionality by holding space bar rather than tapping it
-Spamming 'E' to load torpedoes or put them back in the dispenser should no longer overload them when the connection to the host has high latency
-The "relative to my score" switch on the leaderboard should no longer stay stuck
-Cave enemy ragdolls' scale is now set based on the exact size of the enemy before death
-Fixed a bug causing caves not to spawn in the first layer
-Fixed a bug in music syncing which was causing networking backups and disconnects
-Fixed a bug in miniboss setup code which was causing networking backups and disconnects
-Blobfish should be able to vomit again (and yes, this was also causing networking backups and disconnects)
-Wrote a workaround for a rare Unity bug which appears to have come up when using Chinese characters in text
-Overhauled the backend for the brig to help resolve the problems where players could see outside it, get stuck in it, or teleport around relative to it. Permanent disarming after being brigged while holding a torpedo is still a known issue.
-Fixed a bug causing permanent curtains in the online menu for players trying to join

Balance
-The EMP now does damage less frequently, and deals damage fewer total times before being destroyed
-The torpedo, like the battery, now takes both arms to load, disarming any player holding one until it is loaded or set back int he dispenser
-The EMP now uses a small amount of fuel and cannot be fired without enough fuel available
-Each biome is now guaranteed to have at least one cave and at most three caves.

Other
-New tumbleweed sounds
-New sea monkey sounds
-New blobfish sounds
-New volcanic turtle sounds

Community Highlights

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png

::: Player of the Month :::

July's Player of the Month is... Behemoth270!

Behemoth270 is one of our most active and constructive forum posters, constantly leaving well-thought-out and interesting feedback, while maintaining and understanding that as a small team, we won't always have time or won't always agree to implement many of the suggested posts as-written. But, with the help of Behemoth270's brainstorming threads (along with those who participated, honorable mentions to Banisher, ADcrafter, PigeonMan and JJXDoge) we were able to get closer to what we felt was the best form of implementation for one of our newest mechanics (Fuel). 

Their feedback aside, Behemoth270 has also put a great deal of effort into welcoming and helping teach many of our new community members, even going so far as to write an extensive Tutorial and Strategy Guide for the Official Wiki! Behemoth270 has also shown an effort to be kind and diplomatic in his interactions with other community members, helping keep the WNTGD community a friendly place.

As usual, our Player of the Month Behemoth270 will be sent 4 copies of WNTGD as a reward for their efforts. 

::: Community Content Highlight :::

This month we also want to take some time to highlight a few of the community's creations, namely ones that have made us laugh or ones that simply deserve to be seen more.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=970317384
This first one is a speed-running video by Freemankiller, which is edited in a hilariously tongue-in-cheek fashion, documenting their crew's exploits to "piss off the devs" by speed-running the game with two people in The Requin. The video is surprisingly well-done, and is full of some pretty amusing moments between the comedy montage-style editing. Hats off to you guys and your crazy feats!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/307110/discussions/0/1290691937731945311/

Thanks as always for your ongoing feedback and support, everyone! Let us know what you think of the update as always - so we can continue to improve the game. Happy diving!

notes.title: 0.5.7 Beta is Live! Help Us Test the New Update!
notes.notes:
Hey y'all! So as most of you may know, every 8th we have our big content update complete with new features, bug fixes, etc. Very often however, that update releases with a handful of new problems due to the fact that our own internal testing can only take us so far. So! In the interest of releasing tomorrow's Update in as spit-shine a form as possible, we have pushed the nearly-complete version of the 0.5.7 update into the Beta branch for any interested folks to take a shot at. 

We're not gonna list the full features here for the sake of saving most of the proper announcement stuff for the actual update tomorrow, but here are a few things you can expect to find/we'd like to see tested:

[spoiler]- A New 2-player Vessel (Shield sprites have not been updated yet)
- Built-in Voice Chat button (V by default)
- Potential fixes for non-spawning cave bugs and a handful of brig bugs.
- Fuel System
[/spoiler]

There is of course more in store, but we'll save the laundry list of new features for tomorrow. For now, happy testing and we hope to hear feedback from y'all soon!

How to opt into the beta branch:
1. Go to your Steam library
2. Right-click our game
3. Click "Properties"
4. Click on the "Betas" tab
5. Change from "default" to "beta"

WARNING: Players who opt into the Beta will only be able to play with other Beta players.

EDIT: A hotfix was just pushed to address the JOIN loading screen bug affecting some beta users.

notes.title: Crate Update #3 | The Fiddly Crate (0.5.6) & Summer Event!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d1be1c7d23651c2ad2c5f1c745a6a0b0a95f3fb7.png

Crate shipment ahoy! This time, coming to y'all packed full of new usability features for fiddly fingers, balance tweaks, and much-needed bug fixes, along with long-requested features such as Steam Cloud Saving and Brigs! Along for the ride is the kickoff of our Summer Event, complete with new terrifying foes, treasure, and special cosmetics!

Features

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/708556a13856d382b2cc36fa56ca9b182b157742.png

The Brig! - For all the scallywags and troublemakers out there, prepare to do time for your traitorous crimes in The Brig! The Captain (Host) of the ship can now lock any troublesome crew member in The Brig for a short period of time to show them a lesson in teamwork by utilizing the Player Info Window (Tab). Repeat offenders will spend a longer time in The Brig each time they are sent there, so better learn to behave or rot for your crimes.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6456c1c171292d3b697a27710e0e78734f7e0b34.png

Cloud Saving! - Now available is Steam Cloud Saving! This should now be enabled by default for all users, so you'll be able to take your character's stash of hats, knick knacks, items and depth records on the go! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/95b56be5f6816ccf8bc0c292677f9cb7d89b5ad1.png

New Fiddly Options! - New tweakable options are now available in the Main Menu, letting you optimize/customize your go-to settings for We Need To Go Deeper. Rebind your controls in full from the new Controls window, and adjust the Quality of your graphics from the Options window to better optimize Deeper for lower end machines or crank that anti-aliasing up a notch!


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6bb1dfae9c1cecbb313f341fdcd736836c2a5c91.png

The Wrath of the Sun God Summer Event is now live! 

Legends say every Summer Solstice, the mighty Sun God  awakens, and with Him the many Caskets of his followers rise from the darkest parts of the Earth! These Caskets are filled with many riches, and some will contain one of 4 pieces of beautiful and rare headwear, given to the Sun God as tribute. But beware, for there's a price to pay for waking the dead.. and they don't easily part with their riches.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/6cd9346d1b72da47928220a930f7299164cc4ff8.png

The Sun God will resume His slumber on July 8th.

Balance

- Large gold can now only be found in treasure chests/rubble piles.
- [spoiler]Eldritch Staff now has a unique Eldritch Spawn monster that is far weaker than the Abominations prior. Staff also received +10 damage boost.[/spoiler]
- Cannon mini-gun now creates a distinct path line for each shot to better indicate their aim/direction.
- EMP base damage decreased by 1.
- EMP damage is reduced against bosses when there are fewer players.
- Elixirs are now much more likely to show up in caves and have functionally distinct spawn conditions in the dynamic difficulty system.
-Total minimum cave treasure spawns increased by 2, balanced with slightly reduced likelihood of spawning the largest gold pile from regular chests

Fixes

- The in-game chat paper strips now appear over the loadout screen and game over screen so that players can discuss loadout choices and chat at all times.
- Player names now load and display in the Customization Menu properly, so names should no longer need to be re-entered.
- Grabbing a second item when fully equipped should no longer jarringly swap your active item twice.
- Main power console switch should now be usable in caves but shouldn't be able to fire an EMP.
- Fixed newer cosmetics being unlocked by default by some users.
- EMP and Mini-Gun shots should now be able to damage Tortoises.
- Wrote a failsafe for a very rare bug where a player disconnecting before confirming that they had loaded the submarine interior could prevent interactable submarine elements from being spawned (this is extremely rare so please report cases if you still find them on the forums - you guys are great about this)


Other

- Treasure chests given a visual face-lift with new custom animations and assets! Treasure plundering should be much more satisfying.
- A Periscope visual inside the sub has been added for when players use the Periscope button to look outside (Q).
- The Requin now has a depth meter in the Navigation room.
- Loadout menu slot size increased to use entire space to set correct initial expectations.

-----------------------------------------

That's all she wrote! As always, leave us your feedback and let us know if you run across any new problems, and a big thanks to everyone for constantly helping us drive this game towards being the best it can be! We'll be keeping an eye out on the forums as always!

Happy diving!

notes.title: The Handy Update (0.5.5) | New Items Galore!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a9d2133d19468aa7258b1268995cb266e17d8edc.png

All hands on deck for June's content update! This month is all about putting a variety of handy tools, weapons, and upgrades at your disposal, along with a host of fixes and changes! Let's hop to it!

Content

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/c0333ee4bbc5069fb87dacc9532ed2f6e4caa0bc.png

Five new handy items have been added to the game, each with their own unique strengths and weaknesses! Let's go over each of them, shall we?...

The Phonograph! - This bulky fella will let you expose your crew mates to the joys and wonders of classical music! Your whole team will appreciate your supportive tunes backing the score to them fending for their lives!

The Dynamite! - These explosive, water-resistant wicks of destruction are now at your disposal! Toss and clear out whole groups of enemies in a single blow, or destroy massive armored crabs and clams with but a few well-placed sticks. WARNING: VERY DANGEROUS. USE WITH CAUTION.

The Monkey Wrench! - While its repair speed and damage are average, this monkey wrench lives up to its namesake and makes quite the acrobat out of its wielder! Leap higher and run faster with the agile Monkey Wrench!

The Tesla Gun! - Invented by the famous inventor Nikola himself, the Tesla Gun packs an electric charge that can really deal some damage. Charge up and release powerful clusters of electric energy at your foes!

The Syringe! - This medical marvel allows you to really Doctor it up and perform healing blood transfusions on teammates! Its sharp needle even allows it to be a versatile weapon! WARNING: 5% OF PATIENTS MAY EXPERIENCE SOME DISCOMFORT.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/8091936d60faffbfaed8f4d454af2a35d90c1728.png

A Mystery Weapon! - In addition to the five new items above, a stranger item also lurks beneath the depths of The Living Infinite, waiting for its mysterious power to be unlocked by those willing to dig deep enough to find the key to its release...

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d2bbae23ee91b1f25855a45df9c1b16f864f9352.png

New Submarine Upgrades! - Two new upgrades for your vessel can now be discovered in Crates! Bullet Fire Rate and EMP Damage Upgrades are here!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/a2460abc54361a7033dea41fc7e6761c5534a145.png

Smart Caves! - Caves have received an intelligence overhaul, and will now spawn items, barrels, treasure and upgrades based on the needs (or lack thereof) of your crew! Crews in dire need of supplies are more likely to get what they need to get back on their feet, and crews who are doing well have a higher chance of finding treasure! 
 
Bug Fixes

- Fixed a problem where subHealth updates coming in from SubStats were throwing cheat checker into cheating detected mode.
- Aiming visuals should now work over the network.
- Mini-bosses now spawn at correct sizes.
- Fixed a null reference in cave spines.

Balance

- Submarine Upgrades now have limited spawn rates.
- Adjusted EMP's effects on AIDM rest time numbers. It still tells the AIDM that engines off doesn't count for spawn prevention, but it no longer divides the time in combat numbers so hard.
- Caves are no longer as random! Now you should be set to get 3 caves per level, with the exception of a few extra random factors.
- Gold values adjusted on med/small piles to be slightly less valuable.

Other

- Monthly Leaderboards have been reset.
- Added new biome-specific placeholder bosses for the shallow biomes(!)
- The Rose now has a secondary use other than looking just lovely!
- Visual flair/Particle effects given to a variety of items.
- Skeletal Abomination enemies given new sound effects.
- Item switching now has a sound effect.
- Original Wrench has been given a visual makeover with a new sprite!

Player of the Month

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2ea87470ec5c3e1e09b0b2f693004604ad0112b5.png

June's Player of the Month is... Kimi Kitte!

Kimi Kitte has been an enormous and pivotal help to us devs in crushing some seriously difficult bugs! To date, she has sent us NINETEEN log files along with commentary to describe the events of play sessions. Many times she has sent us the log files of the same game from both a host and a client perspective (this is crazy useful for tracking down networking problems).

notes.title: Hotfix #13 - Crate Update 2 Balance Party
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png

Fun fact: This is actually not the 13th hotfix thanks to a lot of "stealth" fixes we occasionally push after big updates, but today's Crate Update has inspired so many balance/bug reports thanks to its mechanical overhaul nature that we knew we had to make this one public to let you guys know we have been working on getting some of these balance changes in as fast as possible! Without further ado - here's the changelog:

- Altered Minigun's base fire-rate and range to make it more effective in combat, especially against multiple foes.
- Gold drops have slightly higher default values and are set to drop bigger piles more frequently.
- Torpedo Ammunition and Barrels both have been given a much higher chance of spawning.
- Tortoises' colliders fixed to be easier to damage with Minigun bullets.
- Arctic Ice should now be damageable by Minigun bullets.
- Smoldering Shell boss tweaked to be less aggressive.
- Exterior enemies' health code adjusted to allow them to receive damage more frequently. This may have contributed to the minigun's initial ineffectiveness.
- "Charger" enemy types (Swordfish, Narwhals, etc.) health values lowered to make them easier to handle with the new mechanics.
- Fixed bug causing Mini-bosses to not spawn at the correct size.
- Fixed bug causing one of the relics to be improperly tied to the wrong relic identity in the Relic Museum.

Hopefully this should address a good chunk of the feedback we've gotten today, but more balance/fixing work is underway! It's a job that never ends, really. Alas, thanks so much to those who left their feedback promptly today to help us get this stuff in order as quick as possible! Keep it coming guys! :D

notes.title: Crate Update #2 | The Booster Crate (0.5.4)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/28a8375e152b01bf183737e99694c3c4dc1f0882.png

It's time for another catch-all Crate Update shipment - and this time it's practically overflowing with a variety of new big balance changes, tweaks, drinks, and a whole lot of BOOSTERS. Let's unpack this crate to see what's in store, eh?

Features

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/7b1894b97017ac4de8f08fe8b58990f6499f71aa.jpg

The Power Lever! - Power management just got a BOOST with this all new, state-of-the-art Power Lever, just waiting to be flipped at a moment's notice by your trusted engineers. 

Found at the central Power Console, this lever will allow you to BOOST the ship's power into overdrive, sending out a destructive EMP field outside of the ship, damaging anything in its wake. Warning: EMP is unstable and will cause your ship's systems to be shut down after use. You will have to flip the lever back to its normal state to restore power. Use with caution.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/415402ba0c69f8d28d756baf92f405ecea27d03e.jpg

Cannon Overhaul! - The Cannon as you know it has received quite the design facelift this update, all designed to help balance the exciting yet unfortunately tedious task of torpedo loading with the itchy trigger fingers of your average Weapons Specialist. Let's break the changes down piece by piece, shall we?

1. Weapons Power now has only two states. Power Level 1 activates the ship's new built-in BULLET FIRING state; a turret-like state where the Weapons Specialist can rat-a-tat-tat enemies with an endless supply of low-damage bullets without needing to worry about reloading. 

2. Power Level 2 then activates all three Torpedo Tubes as you know them, allowing them to be loaded manually for those times you require maximum firepower. Knowing when to switch between these two states will be pertinent to your team's diving success.

3. Torpedoes are no longer infinite. A counter on top of your local Torpedo Dispenser shows you how many torpedoes you have left. But not to worry, for you can now find new bundles of torpedo ammunition in caves inside of...


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2385f5a9760f4ef490320f6053fddce47b071924.jpg

Barrels! - A new kind of cave drop has been added in the form of these mysteriously labeled barrels! Inside, you can find Torpedo Ammunition, or more rarely, you may find a variety of strange drinks called...

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/8f07f8742bb8fabaa936226a6d751575868f483d.jpg

Elixirs! - These 5 varieties of bottled up liquid miracles each have a unique BOOSTING effect on adventurers who dare drink them. From repair boosts, breath boosts, damage boosts and health boosts, there are a variety of ways you can improve your state-of-being! Warning: Side Effects May Include Unpredictable Downgrades.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/3ed667dec78c6436d5ecf4e99fd7bc70e38c5629.jpg

New Secret Unlockable Cosmetics! - 5 new special cosmetics have been added as secret unlockables via the Code Entry box in the Extras section on the Main Menu. All of these are inspired by various content creators - and you can have them too if you can guess their codes! Here's our hints:

This man is haunted by chants of ire and salt, his violet 'stache is yours if you know who's at fault!

This fellow's name quite literally means "man" - though going by his hair you'd think he's a crayon!

His own head is curly and his fans' are bobbles, this mystery often gets into squabbles!

Often the target of pokes and jeers, this royal bearded 'tuber has Styrofoam fears.

A collector of pogs and rubbery toys, thank god for him and his status as #1 boy.

Balance
- Relics are now slightly more rare
- All of those lovely features above!
- 3 new types of Gold Piles have been added to the game (small, medium, huge) that are worth different values and spawn at different rates.
- Small gold piles are now droppable by several in-game enemies.
- All exterior enemies' health values changed/balanced to accomodate new Bullet state for weapons console.
- Treasure chests no longer spawn health or poison elixirs.

Bug Fixes
- Added a second failsafe check to remove the invisible walls that have been keeping players who load the game slowly trapped in the corners of submarines
- Fixed a problem where some volcanic vents wouldn't make their smoke or bubble particles correctly
- Fixed the bug where the submarine can blow up on one player's screen but not another, causing game-breaking desync. 
- Skeletons of disconnected players should now delete, and will no longer count toward the total dead player count for game over conditions
- Torpedoes of disconnected players now delete
- Found and fixed an index out of bounds exception when spawning the game loop-related monster which caused enemy spawning code to exit early and not return. This should finally solve the problem where enemies stop spawning after the game loops.
- Ghost explosions in caves should not be able to run their damage code twice on the same player anymore
- Fixed a bug where level resets after boss fights could cause players to lose periscope functionality
- Patched a very rare problem where a swimming exterior enemy may be spawned while inside a cave
- Added more exception handling and reference checking for enemy projectile-related code which appeared to be causing large packet buffer buildups (special thanks to Kimi Kitte for the logs showing this!)
- Fixed a series of bugs related to proper scaling and synchronized setup of cave enemies
- Placed invoke cancelations on a multitude of objects which may not have been properly cleaned up by the garbage collector due to invokes still running
- Fixed a bug where a player could request to load a torpedo multiple times with only a single torpedo
- Treasure chests should no longer continue to highlight after being opened.
- Gold pickup sound should no longer be delayed.

Cosmetic Changes
- Submarine propellers animate now!
- Several biomes have had a color overlay overhaul to improve their overall look!
- The lights on the inside of the sub now flicker and swing around when the submarine is hit! They also turn red when the submarine is almost fully breached, turn extra bright during an EMP, and turn off altogether when the Power Lever is in the bottom position.
- New Gold pickup particle effect added.
- Gold piles now glow.
- Newspaper headline image changed to be submarine neutral.
- Health and Poison Elixirs' look has been overhauled to match the new visual style for elixirs.

Extras
- Mid-game ESCAPE menu reworked and given added Options functionality! Now you can finally change volume options mid-game!

notes.title: The Nook and Cranny Update (0.5.3) | Relics, Leaderboards, and Fixes Galore!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/b7ba7e7b8c32e3cc2b235bfa243d94a8d74c900b.png

Put your explorer's cap on for May's official content update! It's here, and we've littered it with all sorts of hidden goodies. Hidden being the key word here, as some of the most beneficial stuff coming with this update is under the hood. They may not be the flashiest, but they are integral to ensuring your future Deeper experiences go as smoothly as possible. 

We tried to patch as many nooks, and cram as much content in all the crannies, that we could find. Without further ado - let's go over the changes:

Content

Relics!

Lore! Lore up the cranny!

The mysterious hidden Relics are finally here for you to seek and collect throughout The Living Infinite's various cave systems; These Relics range from ancient idols, to petrified creatures, to undiscovered messages in bottles and more, each with their own story to tell about themselves and the world of The Living Infinite! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/63536d7375a2776a4ebc1e2129df12f51f5c7ccd.png

But what are Relics without a museum to display them? Once discovered, you can view all of your collected undersea artifacts in the ever-expanding Relic Museum - now accessible from the Play Menu!

Leaderboards!

Ever want to prove to your peers that your expeditions are truly the deepest? Well now you can, with Steam Leaderboard support!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/fdd01858905c9442122da1a22c5c4840c5ffcd74.png

It's not much to look at now, though we hope to see you guys fill it in no time!

Each vessel will be judged on their own merits, so submarines each have their own leaderboards to keep those rank-chasers on their toes! Additionally, given our frequent balance changes, we'll be resetting these boards every month so the top dogs will have to fight to keep their places as lords of the ocean, and everyone else should always have a decent fighting chance at placing on the board! Crews will have identical scores at the end of their sessions, so no one has to worry about glory hogs.

Bug Fixes

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/333577b1b952042d3113b4d7283fdaa5973accaa.png

Ahh the unsung heroes. We dedicated a LOT more time to these this month because these babies were really starting to pile up, so a little bit of Spring Cleaning was necessary. Check out these bad boys:

-Fixed a huge bug which was causing save files to stop working when new items were added.
-Fixed the issue where the two cannons on the Requin appear in the wrong place.
-Fixed a bug where the Requin weapons consoles could control the wrong cannon.
-Fixed two more sources of invisible leaks/dents. Gone forever?? Only time will tell!
-Default names in chat are now your steam name, rather than "Nameless."
-Fixed the local rotation of your player's arm being set wrong after dying.
-Fixed messages being sent in-game when there was no text.
-Fixed one source of a bug causing the depth meter text to not appear.
-Made an extra check to ensure that gold is only permanently removed if saving a purchase was successful.
-Made an extra check to ensure that catalog buttons only disappear if their purchase is saved successfully.
-Fixed a rare issue where two network interfaces can have their IPs broadcasted simultaneously when hosting online.
-Made a new non-buffering position syncing component for players and interior enemies, freeing TONS of network buffer space and reducing TONS of traffic.
-Changed the primary networking channel from being reliable ordered to reliable fragmented - should help players rebound after a lag spike.
-Added a series of points which help the submarines detect being trapped inside rocks (caused by a level chunk spawned after a lag spike) and teleport out - doesn't catch all cases but significantly reduces the problem EDIT:  This fix caused more problems than it solved. This will be patched out until we get a better solution

Balance

-Number of volcanic sea monkeys invading the submarine reduced 25%
-Sea monkey health reduced by 40%
-Boar invader health reduced 10%
-Sea monkey and boar exterior shrub objects are twice as large
-Ghost pirate health reduced by 50%
-Miscellanous difficulty segmenting changes in the AIDM for better spawn rates in the volcanic area
-Changed first-layer water type probabilities. There is now a 50% chance to get Atlantic, 30% chance to get Stormy, and 20% chance to get Arctic.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

That's it, happy relic hunting - and be sure to let us know what ya'll think in the comments, forums, etc. as usual! Thanks everyone! ːsteamhappyː

Each vessel will be judged on their own merits, so submarines each have their own leaderboards to keep those rank-chasers on their toes! Additionally, given our frequent balance changes, we'll be resetting these boards every month so the top dogs will have to fight to keep their places as lords of the ocean, and everyone else should always have a decent fighting chance at placing on the board! Crews will have identical scores at the end of their sessions, so no one has to worry about glory hogs.

Bug Fixes

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/333577b1b952042d3113b4d7283fdaa5973accaa.png

Ahh the unsung heroes. We dedicated a LOT more time to these this month because these babies were really starting to pile up, so a little bit of Spring Cleaning was necessary. Check out these bad boys:

-Fixed a huge bug which was causing save files to stop working when new items were added.
-Fixed the issue where the two cannons on the Requin appear in the wrong place.
-Fixed a bug where the Requin weapons consoles could control the wrong cannon.
-Fixed two more sources of invisible leaks/dents. Gone forever?? Only time will tell!
-Default names in chat are now your steam name, rather than "Nameless."
-Fixed the local rotation of your player's arm being set wrong after dying.
-Fixed messages being sent in-game when there was no text.
-Fixed one source of a bug causing the depth meter text to not appear.
-Made an extra check to ensure that gold is only permanently removed if saving a purchase was successful.
-Made an extra check to ensure that catalog buttons only disappear if their purchase is saved successfully.
-Fixed a rare issue where two network interfaces can have their IPs broadcasted simultaneously when hosting online.
-Made a new non-buffering position syncing component for players and interior enemies, freeing TONS of network buffer space and reducing TONS of traffic.
-Changed the primary networking channel from being reliable ordered to reliable fragmented - should help players rebound after a lag spike.
-Added a series of points which help the submarines detect being trapped inside rocks (caused by a level chunk spawned after a lag spike) and teleport out - doesn't catch all cases but significantly reduces the problem EDIT:  This fix caused more problems than it solved. This will be patched out until we get a better solution

Balance

-Number of volcanic sea monkeys invading the submarine reduced 25%
-Sea monkey health reduced by 40%
-Boar invader health reduced 10%
-Sea monkey and boar exterior shrub objects are twice as large
-Ghost pirate health reduced by 50%
-Miscellanous difficulty segmenting changes in the AIDM for better spawn rates in the volcanic area
-Changed first-layer water type probabilities. There is now a 50% chance to get Atlantic, 30% chance to get Stormy, and 20% chance to get Arctic.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

That's it, happy relic hunting - and be sure to let us know what ya'll think in the comments, forums, etc. as usual! Thanks everyone! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: May Content Update Temporarily Delayed - Player of the Month Announced!
notes.notes:
EDIT: These problems have been resolved thanks in big part to the awesome developers of the connection tool we use! Expect the update shortly! 

Hey guys! Okay, we know how bad this looks coming in late again after having showed up late to the party with the Fully Loaded update. Actually the circumstances are kind of different this time. We built out the content update in time (as far as we felt could safely be done in the time given) and then.... okay this is gonna get slightly technical.

Let's Get Technical

The connection tool we use to get you fine folks hooked into one another had an update released which had some unexpected problems. The connection success rate with the update among our team dropped noticeably. While this is unfortunate, we don't fault the good folks developing the tool - their team is about the same size as ours, and we know that testing can be limited when you're small. In fact, we're not without fault here by any means. I personally (this is Jordan here) failed to set up my firewall correctly on my new work computer and dramatically increased the time required for testing, contributing greatly to the holdup and failures - talk about a taste of your own medicine, eh?

So, the question we would expect here is: why can't you go back? Can't you just use the old version of the connection tool? Yes! And no! Okay, so Unity's asset store works in a funny (but not 'ha-ha' funny) kind of way. Once you update an asset from the store, there is no going back to a previous version (including reverting from your git or DVCS version control software). So in order to revert, we have to have a previous version built and sent to us from the creators of the connection tool. Once we have that in place, we can finally connect to one another well enough to test all the cool new content and network-related fixes we've been adding! Finally, we will be able to release the update we built!
EDIT AGAIN: that build got sent to us! Thanks again! 

Player of the Month

But, like last time our update didn't come out in time, we still want to announce our Player of the Month! 

After much deliberating, we've picked JJxDoge!
JJxDoge has been an avid player since just after launch, and has done a fantastic job of keeping the forums a lively place for discussion. He is always promoting participation in the Deeper community, in addition to helping us nail down Mac compatibility! Whether JJxDoge is posting feedback in the forums, detailing bug reports, contributing to the Wiki, or showing up our livestreams to feed us a steady stream of topics and questions to bounce off of, JJxDoge is always there. He is one of our most active and lighthearted community members, and for that, we think he deserves to be May's Player of the Month.

As usual, JJxDoge will be recieving 4 free copies of We Need To Go Deeper to distribute at his will, and will be displayed on the Main Menu until next month's update!

Thanks once again JJxDoge, and thanks to everyone for helping us keep the game chugging along! The We Need To Go Deeper community is ever-growing thanks to all of you folks helping us spread the word, and we couldn't be more grateful! ːsteamhappyː

Note: because of our inability to produce any Steam builds unti the connection tool problem had been fixed, the main menu didn't reflect JJxDoge's top-dog status as player of the month until we got it fixed. Super sorry about that bud!

notes.title: The Fully Loaded Update (0.5.0) | New Submarine, Biome Overhaul, and More!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/9d09b719b46d0ae188e92aefec3fb44606a3f25c.png

This was a tough one to deliver, but April's official content update is finally here, and it's FULLY LOADED. "The Requin" Vessel has arrived, along with a complete overhaul for one of our biomes and a small helping of new cosmetics and bug-fixes! See for yourself on the full changelog below:

 Content 

 A Brand New Vessel: The Requin!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/b5ec13973eb7f0a42f6a1f303347a4a3c0f8bb24.png

The bigger, bulkier, and well-armed Requin is now available for you to crew for your future expeditions! The Requin is a militaristic submarine meant for those with larger 3-4-man crews; armed with TWO cannons from the start, but without the shielding capabilities of The Crevette. Being bigger comes with its advantages of course, since The Requin also comes with two beds and more breathing space for when things get hectic.


Cursed Waters Biome Overhaul!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/d9ece768d0b99200d81d7c9ff85ca27fafccb39f.png

The Cursed Water Biome has, for a while, been considered by many of our playerbase to be the ugliest and most tedious biome to start out with. After seeing how the biome was being recieved, we decided to take it upon ourselves to overhaul the whole biome from scratch! The Cursed Waters is no longer the colorless, empty-looking, ghost-filled biome you knew before, but has now taken on a whole new vibrantly spooky look, complete with several new enemy types and mechanic changes! 

Here is a summary of some of the new changes to the Cursed Waters Biome:

- No longer does every enemy leave behind a ghost upon death, but only "Cursed" enemies distinguished by their decayed look. We recommend if you see a Cursed enemy to leave it be, because...

- Ghosts are no longer killable! That's right, your weapons cannot harm things that are not from the physical realm. When a ghost spawns, it will seek vengeance by heading towards its' former killer and exploding itself into a ghostly ether of rage.

- Mysterious and wicked Bone Shrines now litter the caves and walls of the Cursed Waters; we advise you leave them alone, for disturbing these shrines will cause dangerous Skeletal Abominations to form from the bones of their resting place!

- Cursed Shipwrecks of pirate voyages long passed still sail these seas, seeking victims to board and plunder with their crews of mold-encrusted pirates.

- A strange Mold will now grow inside your vessel when taking on water, and it has a mind of its own..


New Submarine Tilesets!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/ea2afd960f4d66ad9398691892e08b92c59de06c.png

Up until now, the submarine floors, backgrounds, and interior decoration has all been done via a single large hand-drawn file that made up the entirety of all decor in the sub. In other words, it's all been hard baked in until now.

 I'll be the first to say this was a stupid idea, and since we plan to have many new submarines in the future, a more modular tileset strategy was required, but it also gave opportunity to design a new cooler look for everything! Now all floors are made up of these cutaway view tiles with all the innerworkings and pipework on display, and all decor, pictures, etc. can be hand placed by designers! This will allow for easier creation of subs by our team and may even open up possibilities for sub "skins" in the future!

New Cosmetics!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/1321c3b3eddd9b178b20aff12f31da552ab41768.png

Four new potential looks for your adventurers have been added to the Catalog, half of which were fan suggestions! Whether you want to showcase your childish side with the Spin Cap, your wicked side with the Voodoo Stovepipe, your sailor side with the Rain Gear, or your pigeon side with the Pigeon Suit, we've gotcha covered!

Fixes

-Our networking system now tries to choose the best possible network adapter to host on when hosting online games by ignoring network adapters designed for VPNs or virtual machines
-Player names can no longer get covered by hair
-Doors no longer produce gore when hit
-Long games and multiple time devourer appearances no longer stops enemies from spawning
-Updated connection tool *should* prevent 5-player games (let us know if it doesn't)
-Minibosses should now show their names and effects properly between host and clients
-Curtains no longer pop open for a moment before closing again when reaching the loadout menu

Balance

-The pump now bails 50% more water per pump
-Siren has been toughened up quite a bit (faster, stronger, attacks more often, hits a lot harder) to make her a more serious threat to be avoided
-Every aformentioned change to the Cursed Waters biome
-Time devourer moves 10% faster to engage the submarine

Regressions

-The "Loading Aventure..." message stops showing for a moment during loading, then comes back

Inside Look: What Goes Into An Update?

Since this update took nearly a whole extra week to get a stable version out to you guys, we thought it might be pertinent to share a little peek into what goes into a content update for We Need To Go Deeper. The following images are of every one of our Source Control pushes (Source Control being a system that allows us to share files,scripts, etc. with one-another as we work remotely), from when we began working on the update to when we finished it. This is not even counting the work that happens outside of these pushes, such as the creation of new sounds, assets, etc. (Though I blacked out spoilers for pushes which involved work for an upcoming update):

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/4f9b1141b8cbda87bf30bc2930d42bfd22c87ef8.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f3c7c37dc9e9f7b85b118e21551631ba9a3c2e2e.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/fbbe99f023ddea7f257ada2b3f4e8502899916e3.png

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thanks again to everyone for all of your continous feedback and support! Let us know what you'd like to see next as always, and of course keep us updated in the forums regarding any new bugs that may prop up. We're gonna need y'all testing this particular update extra thoroughly, as adding a new submarine has proven to be one of the biggest undertakings, and many, MANY systems had to be reworked to support it, so we fully expect there to be a few things out of place. Let us know what those things are as soon as possible, so we can patch 'em up quick! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/4d52716c264352c698ee893185b210e265798eca.png

Stay alert, comrades.

notes.title: April's Content Update Has Been Delayed :(
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/cfe342a31cfd3e1f4b3dde88481be53f459c74e8.png

Wyell...

It was only a matter of time that we bit off more than we could chew for a month-long update, and that time has arrived. While most of the other features that we planned for the next update are in place and working, the biggest, most requested feature - the new submarine - is still not complete.

We Need to Go Deeper was built over the course of 4 years or so (with an engine change in the middle) with a single, reliable, ever-present submarine. When we listened to the overwhelming consensus from our players that it was time for a new submarine, we thought we could accomplish that in a month. As it turns out, when you build essentially the whole game in such a way that the submarine is always there, UN-doing that means rewriting parts in nearly all aspects of the game. In fact, rather than listing which parts of our game we had to change, here's the list of things in our game which DIDN'T have to change to accommodate a new submarine:

1. Cave generation
2. Exterior level generation
3. Interior enemy AI
4. Exterior enemy AI
5. Main menu
6. Play menu
7. Customization menu
8. Player handling (controls, weapons, position).

Everything else has either been changed or is going to be. In fact, it's possible that some very small changes will still need to be performed on a few items in that list which we haven't found yet.

Which is why... 
We need beta testers!

So much in the game has changed to accommodate the new submarine that essentially everything needs testing once again! Whether or not it's totally 100% stable and working, we will release the entirety of everything we have for this update to the Beta branch as soon as possible. How do you get into the beta? Simply right click our game in your Steam library, go to "Properties", and select "Beta" as your branch from the "Betas" tab!

We're really sorry that we couldn't meet our deadline this month, but every additional submarine from here on will be easier. In software engineering terms, we're paying off lots of our "technical debt." Bear with us for a little longer here and have fun testing the new features early if you like!

Thanks everybody!

notes.title: Crate Update #1 | The Pumped Crate (0.4.6)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/87eec9a0f686bab5cc2496c71b8600657d9acea6.png

This week we're introducing our very first "Crate Update" - a new subset of smaller scale content updates that we hope to roll out around the middle of every month when we can (no guarantees), to supplement the time between our larger and bulkier content updates that we schedule for the 8th of every month. They're "Crate" updates because unlike our larger content updates, these are more of a mess of random tiny features or items that we're bundling together in a cute little crate to ship your way! 

Without further ado, let's get into this month's Crate Update -

This particular Crate Update is all about PUMPING. Here's what the PUMPED CRATE has in store for y'all:

PUMPED Interior Combat! - We've added a ton of new feedback from juicy blood-spurts to giving enemies a good visual shake-down/jitter when damaged;  all to make interior combat that much more satisfying and pumped up! 

PUMPED Interior Mini-Bosses! - To help [strike]spice[/strike] pump up cave and interior enemy encounters further, any given interior foe now has a small chance of spawning as one of several Mini-Boss variants! You'll recognize these Mini-Bosses by their distinct colors and equally colorful names. Approach with caution however, as Mini-Bosses come with several varieties of stat boosts - from bulkier armor to faster feet to sharper pincers... these colorful critters are not to be trifled with.

The PUMP Item! - Perhaps the pumpiest of all the new features is our brand new Water Pump Item! This bulky fella will allow you to manually pump flood-water out of your ship and into the ether! Help your fellow crewmates stave off drowning by clearing their rooms of water in a pinch! A persistent pumper can even help slow the flow in a hectic situation, and buy their crew more time to save themselves from imminent destruction!

PUMPED UI! - In addition to fixing some scaling and usability issues with some of our UI, we've also added in a UI element for the Weapons Console to showcase how many torpedo tubes are ready for use or loaded, for maximum team synergy! (Oh god I feel so dirty for using "synergy" in a sentence. I need to go lie down.)

ADDITIONAL PUMP-WORTHY CHANGES:

 Sound: 

-Time devourer sounds
-Boar sounds
-Volcanic shark sounds
-Volcanic squid sounds
-Grenadier sounds
-Rivet gun sounds

Fixes:

-Fixed a bug which caused wall barnacles to grow to enormous sizes on computers running the game faster than the host
-Fixed a bit of UI weirdness with the main menu and play menu
-Fixed a problem where a skeleton could get made way offscreen, making it impossible to revive
-Fixed a problem where breaks and dents would continue to be made even after the sub gets blown up (should reduce slowdowns post-game)
-Fixed a bug which didn't allow you to see when a player wasn't holding anything in their hands over the network
-Solved a series of potential memory problems caused by objects still invoking after destruction (may solve network buffer overflows caused by trying to sync position on dead enemies who failed to fully delete)
-Optimized the way in which players are targeted by interior enemies (should reduce slowdowns during hectic interior times)
-Fixed a problem which caused certain items to show up in the wrong hand by default
-Correctly networked the swing state of other players' arms (hopefully this means you will see hit-stop from other players better)

Balance:

-Sword damage reduced slightly
-Rivet gun now fixes a hull breach in 1 shot, and a dent in 1 shot
-Rivet gun takes slightly longer to reload
-Interior and cave enemies now exhibit slightly more complex behavior to disperse better and are more challenging

Let us know what you guys think as always, and happy diving!
