notes.title: Hotfix #12 (0.4.5f2) - Better VPN Support, Customization Fixes and More!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png

Fix notes:

- Fixed the "Stewart Standard" bug where entering the customization room twice would cause your costume to not load.

- Rivet Gun has recieved more balancing tweaks: Rivet gun now has a slightly longer reload time to put a greater emphasis on precision and fixes dents much slower. (It still fixes leaks in one shot however)

- Added encryption to certain pieces of lobby data. This should prevent pirates with incompatible versions of the game from joining your game. No longer should you see Stewart Standards popping into your game and causing massive packet buildup and lag (incompatible versions are unable to interpret several packets and will request those same packets over and over and over again). 

- Added a new option when creating a LAN game to pick the network interface to host on! This is a tad bit confusing, but should make your LAN success rates extremely high, especially with VPN services like Hamachi. As an example, say that you want to create a game on your Hamachi VPN with a friend. You name your LAN lobby as usual, but now you pick Hamachi out of the next interface rather than your standard WiFi or ethernet adapter. Now, rather than using your normal home LAN, the game is actually broadcasting the correct information over Hamachi to be joined properly. Internally, this fixed Hamachi compatibility for us.

Alternatively, if you are hosting on your real LAN, simply ensuring that you're hosting through the network adapter connected to that LAN will ensure people on your network can join.

***As a side note, if you are using Hamachi or another VPN, ONLY LAN games will work for you. We tested joining online games with Hamachi enabled, and it universally fails. Please make sure to turn off VPNs before joining online games. ***

notes.title: The Hot and Heavy Update (0.4.5) | New Biome, Enemies, and More!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/19b5461476100eb82b2e8b6136bfcdd4524e057c.png

Things are getting steamy with March's official Content Update! This is our first big content update and although most of our time this past month has been utilized to fix bugs and push some big patches, we think you guys will be happy with just how much we managed to stuff into this hot plate. Take a look!

Content

The Volcanic Depths Biome!  - The hot, dangerous, and jungle-like Volcanic Depths are now here for your crew to explore! A variety of new dangers await in this new dark third layer - from Gigantic Armored Tortoises to Nefarious Sea Monkeys, to Gaseous Vents that litter the walls and the very water itself which will boil you alive if you let too much of it in your vessel. This new biome will show your crew the meaning of pain.

New Universal Enemies! - These are enemies that will catch you off guard no matter what biome you may be in, in order to keep some of the more experienced crews on their toes. From Ensaring Bubbles to Sneaky Hermit Crabs, players navigating any area should be at the ready.

The Rivet Gun! - An all-new tool has been added to the roster in the form of this state-of-the-art Rivet Gun: An Engineer's Best Friend! This bulky fella can repair leaks and dents from a distance, and a good one at that - though it's not advised for use in combat - the rivets it fires are known to mostly annoy enemies more than it harms them.

A [spoiler]Loop-Exclusive[/spoiler] Enemy! - For those skilled enough to [spoiler]make it to the Time Portal,[/spoiler] a nasty surprise awaits you and your crew in the form of a monstrous new enemy type...

New Customization Items! - A variety of new hats and costumes have been added to the game; many of which have been fan requests! Including a new hat type: Masks! From Tiki masks to Dramatic Theatre masks to technological marvels like the Gas Mask, now you can finally hide your shameful face from the world!

Bubbles! - Last but not least, our underwater game now finally features bubbles! Bubbles everywhere! We've got bubbles to liven up the outside world, bubbles for boiling, bubbles for propellers, bubbles for DAYS.

Fixes

- Fixed a bug which was causing gore to be continuously activated and deactivated over and over offscreen, causing increasing performance slowdowns over time. This fix has caused big framerate increases, especially late in the game!

- Added more redundancy to reduce the chance of hazards spawning on top of one another. 

- Freed up hazard spawn points whose hazard has been destroyed for reuse (very useful for giant bubbles).

- Fixed one source of unfixable leaks caused by scaling problems.

- Fixed those dumb little graphical artifact dots on the submarine's lights.

- Fixed bug which could cause massive packet buffering if traffic was preventing the music manager from sending over the next music change command.

- Fixed a problem where floating enemies which had spawned from inside chests were unable to be un-spawned over the network after leaving a cave.

- Fixed a similar graphical glitch to the "blue overlay" glitch found by some users in the catalog scene.

- Fixed that annoying bug which allowed torpedoes to explode when hitting teeny tiny rock particles.

- Fixed several costume pivots to stop underwear from showing around edges of an outfit.

Balance

- The submarine is now 20% heavier (we didn't call it hot and HEAVY for nothin'!) and has 50% less linear drag. Driving is a much more engaged job and crashing is easier!

- The submarine's max speed before upgrades is now 2.8 times base speed rather than 3.

- The effects of adding power to the cannon are much more pronounced. 
 Each power added above 1 increases the cannon rotation speed by 25% (a 3-powered cannon spins at 150% of base speed).

- The submarine's shields recharge faster when more power is added, 12.5% per power unit above 1.

- The submarine's base shield recharge rate has been decreased to accommodate the previous balance.

- The Barnacle Harvester is now a "Stopper" type hazard. Rather than punching the sub over and over, it now grabs the sub and hangs onto it until being killed with torpedoes. 

- Water effects now take into account player number. The time between spawning ghost fish, placing ice on doors, etc. is now significantly more influenced by players, as is the total number of water effects spawnable.

-The rate at which enemy spawning decisions is calculated is now better tied to player number.

- The total number of spawnable enemies is better tied to player number.

- Hull upgrade adds 5 hull integrity rather than 10.

- Engine upgrade increases speed 5% rather than 7.5%

- Shield upgrades increase shield recharge rate 5% rather than 7.5%

- Cannon rotation upgrades increase cannon rotation speed 5% rather than 7.5%

- Many enemies' sight distances and speeds have been changed in response to the new driving.

Player Of The Month

This was a particularly tough choice for us, as so many of you have been so helpful and contributed to the forum discussions in many ways over the course of our first month of release! Seriously, the community has been astounding and we couldn't be happier to have you guys. It eventually came down to those of you who have been helping us in even more tangible ways - aka helping us answer repeated bug reports, helping direct people to places where they can find help, and even creating a thread for said help! And with that, our Player of the Month for March is none other than Ketrai!

Ketrai has contributed in bulk in this short first month we've been released - having set up a very helpful FAQ Thread on the Steam Forums, Constantly adding content and managing edits to the Official Wiki for the game, having become an admin over at the Wiki recently! He is also ever-present on the forums, answering the questions of other users or clarifying misunderstandings whenever he can. He's also contributed a ton of feedback in the feedback section, a lot of which led us to many of the balance changes in this very update! Ketrai will be recieving 4 copies of We Need to Go Deeper for his efforts; Thanks for helping us out!

With that said, we want to throw out an additional Special Mention to Steam user THEE_PIANO_MAN - who has served as our first ever Forum Moderator, and has similarly helped us out a TON with repeat bug reports and issues, and has helped spread his friendly and helpful attitude among the forums as a whole! THEE_PIANO_MAN will be recieving 2 extra copies of the game as well to celebrate his contributions!

Thanks again to all of you, and we hope you like the update! Let us know in the comments and forums as usual, and help us keep improving We Need to Go Deeper!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/e27c63542e7db03af97202510660034429ae92fc.png

notes.title: Hotfix #11 (0.4.2f5) - Fixed another Steam Crash, Version Checking for Lobby Listings
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png

Fix notes!

- Much better exception handling when starting loadout choices (No more crashing when confirming loadouts).

- Added several more checks before sending/receiving asynchronous Steam lobby data. Data coming in at a bad time due to random chance will be disregarded.

- Added a backend check for version compatibility when joining lobbies. You can no longer join a lobby whose version is not the same as yours. This will be a big help in reducing the number of lobby listings generated by pirates and those who have old versions (and therefore CRC Mismatches, forced disconnects, etc...). This should mean a slight overall boost to connection success rates!

notes.title: Hotfix #10 (0.4.2f4) - Even More Connection Success Rate Work!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png

Who needs an introduction? We've got new stuff to help success rates across the board, so take a look at these hot details:

- New faster methods for gathering public IP address. You should wait less time for the primary IP source. Let us know if this needs adjusting.

- Fixed a problem with Steam lobby data being incompletely written after the host loaded the lobby scene. This should mean much fewer "Failed to Get Steam Lobby Data" messages.

- Ensured that only lobbies where the host has actually loaded the game are listed in the online browser. Helps ensure that the host is ready to listen for punchthrough.

- Upped the disconnect and ping timeouts. This means you will see "Failed to Connect" after "Success! Loading adventure..." less frequently, but it WILL take longer for disconnected players to be deleted from the game. We hope to bring this back down when we have our more permanent solution built in for keeping the line active during loading.

- Fixed one of the most common ways for getting console desync. Players should see each other floating around less and consoles should be locked out significantly less. Some more console locking problems still exist and are being worked on actively.

- Forced Steam lobby member limit to 4 to ensure that lobbies don't accidentally overfill due to several players attempting to join too quickly. Should overall reduce overfill probabilities and competition problems for lobby slots.

- Better logging for players who send output_log or Player.log to us devs!

- Increased the "f" number on our version to 4! Feature of the year?

NOTE: This WILL cause a "CRC Mismatch" between versions. This means that people who have not yet updated to the latest hotfix will be unable to successfully connect to those who have updated to the latest hotfix. Please be patient with players who have not quit and updated yet. This generally resolves within a few hours.

- Forced Steam lobby member limit to 4 to ensure that lobbies don't accidentally overfill due to several players attempting to join too quickly. Should overall reduce overfill probabilities and competition problems for lobby slots.

- Better logging for players who send output_log or Player.log to us devs!

- Increased the "f" number on our version to 4! Feature of the year?

NOTE: This WILL cause a "CRC Mismatch" between versions. This means that people who have not yet updated to the latest hotfix will be unable to successfully connect to those who have updated to the latest hotfix. Please be patient with players who have not quit and updated yet. This generally resolves within a few hours.

notes.title: Hotfix #7 - Connection Success Rate Boost!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png

Congratulations! Connection success rates are getting a very big boost! 

Here's what's new:

- Ensured that dual-stack routers are getting their IPv4 address returned (currently only works if you can reach ipv4.icanhazip.com  but we will upgrade our secondary IP checker to do the same soon). That IPv4 address is now what other players will use to connect to.

- Reduced loading times on getting to the game scene, moved some object creation slightly forward in time. This will help reduce the number of perceived connection failures which are solely caused by loading the scene for too long without pinging the server. A more robust fix is underway to decrease these unnecessary disconnects further.

- Removed the IPv6 warning for users with dual-stack routers which manage to get their public IPv4 address.

- CAREFULLY re-integrated relay connections. The matchmaking backend is tested before online games can be created or joined, and relay use is turned off if the Unity matchmaking services are unresponsive. We are still looking at a more long-term solution to the problem of matches only being listed for a short time (this does not affect Steam matches, which is what you see in the "Join" browser). If the correct Unity match is not found, you will still connect to the game, just without using the relays.

- Better exception handling on the game's internal restart.

- Reduced the amount of redundant metadata written to Steam lobbies.

notes.title: The (Tiny) Valentine Update | Privacy, Roses, and more!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/9327c21cec0463f63275dff5665c6f377aaa7d78.png

Things are getting steamy with today's update... Whether you're a lover or a fighter, there's something here for you...

Features

- Password protected lobbies! For lovers in need of a little more...privacy.

- Lobby chat! Because people in healthy relationships communicate.

Content

- The Rose Item: Show everyone how much your love is worth by sinking a fortune on this beautiful flower!

- New hats to showcase your romantic side: Romeo, Juliet, and Saint Valentine hats now available in the Catalog.

- An additional hat to show off your Goat side: Our Goat Lord has been rewarded for his hat suggestion. His followers will be most pleased.

- Lover's Tragedy Elixir: A new mysterious Elixir has found its way into the caves... drink it and be with your loved ones for all eternity.

Balance

- Increasing power to the cannon increases its rotation speed! Aiming with 3 power to weapons is 25% faster than aiming with 1 power to weapons.

- The AIDM is better at predicting the amount of rest time needed after an onslaught of enemies.

-The AIDM can now spawn enemies down on you if you sit too long with shields off mid-level.

-The gold multiplier which increases every time your water type changes is now capped at 4.

Stability

- Better error reporting and status reporting when creating and joining online games.

- Better error handling in crash-prone pieces of the game's internal restart.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/75a01e2d6ade7f2618680b7c98c12bcf60ce0554.png

[strike]Happy[/strike] Sensual diving everyone!

notes.title: Hotfix #5 - Steam Crash Fix
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png

This is a simple but important fix - as we have recently narrowed down some of our crash reports and network issues to Unity's relay services being unresponsive in some parts of the country. For those who were experiencing the "crash after hosting/joining" bug, this should fix that!

It should be noted this won't solve connection success rates for people who have had trouble hosting (likely those with IPv6 addresses) - it just ensures the game won't outright crash when those connections fail.

Success rates should be similar to what they were prior to these crashes (they were more frequent today due to problems on Unity's servers today). So overall everyone should have an easier time joining games after today's hotfix.

notes.title: Hotfix #4 - Blank screen fix and more!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png

Today's patch has been a long time brewing; but we finally think we got things sorted out with this "blank/bluescreen" graphical error that some of you with heavier duty custom built PC's have been running into! Along with this, we've managed to fix a bunch of other nagging bugs that y'all have been helping us find in the forums! Take a look at the full list of fixes:

WARNING: This patch will create a CRC mismatch between versions, which means you won't be able to join anyone without this patch. Please allow time for others to download the patch themselves.

- Blank/Blue-screen menu bug should be fixed for most if not all of those having the problem! 

- The Hammerhead shark and the Goblin shark should be able to deal damage again, and all other similar enemy types should be behaving a little more consistently!

- (Hopefully) fixed the problems people are having with desync on who's using the console (causing people to appear to be jumping around and others unable to use that console).

- Fixed the costume unlocking bug for clients! Now clients should be able to unlock costumes properly without having to host their own game. NOTE: May require players delete their data to work properly (From the main menu select Extras > Delete Save).

- Loading times should be slightly less lengthy; particle initialization now occurs AFTER connection. Should help slightly with connection success rates.

- Butcher Knife should be able to make Meat Chunks again!

- Fixed enemy sounds not playing for clients.

- Some difficulty balancing across all water types! Things should be ever so slightly tougher for early areas.

- Fixed Barnacle Biter and Barnacle Maw from spinning like crazy.

- Double clicking on a lobby will now automatically join the lobby.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always, keep us up to date on any problems you run into!

notes.title: Hotfix #3 - Information Highway
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png

Today's hotfix continues our mission to get networking stable/working as much as possible for everyone. We're not all the way there yet, so the secondary purpose of this hotfix is to help us gather more specific information from those experiencing troubles.

WARNING: This patch will create a CRC mismatch between versions, which means you won't be able to join anyone without this patch. Please allow time for others to download the patch themselves.

Here's the gist of what we have packaged up in this patch:

- Better error reporting to replace 'waiting for online components to initialize' with more specific information.

- Fixed infinite spawning barnacles/algae/interior enemies bug.

- Added message to help identify hosts who will have more trouble getting players to join.

- Added "Bug Report" button to main menu to streamline reporting.

- Modified AIDM to have harsher difficulty ramping upon looping.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ADDITIONALLY! 

While we are working on repairing things on our end, we may have found a workaround option so that some of you having troubles hosting have something to try if you don't want to wait for an official fix:

Forwarding port 7777 should help improve hosting success rates.

Again, so sorry about the technical issues everyone, but rest assured we are all working on figuring out fixes constantly. These new error reports should help us nail down quicker which issues folks are running into, so hopefully this will help speed up the process.

notes.title: Hotfix #1 - Network Stability Fixes
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/f2a85cab1715d0a6018e2b7100f97d3b77972a54.png

Thanks so much for your patience with us as we've tried to seek out and address some of the common problems most of you have been running into on launch day. The Deli team has been scrambling to get some of these issues ironed out! 

Here are today's Hotfixes:

- Reduced random disconnects after big game events like changing water layers.

- Increased connection success rates among players who have to try several times before they successfully connect to the same person.

- Fixed a rare bug which caused barnacles to grow indefinitely on certain client machines.

- Reduced unnecessary packets in the atlantic waters.

-----------------------------

Hopefully this will help some of you have an easier time connecting! There are a few more stickler issues we're working on fixes for, we'll try and push these as soon as they are ready! 

Additionally: Please note that you may still have network problems if you do not meet our minimum system requirements. 

Thanks again to all of you for making this a stellar launch day! We are amazed by how patient and kind most of you have been about these issues as they've propped up. We're trying our best to make sure you all have a functional product! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: The Launch Update | Our First Player of the Month!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25605478/2145e5535591aea1d022313fdd5ca64079b7dea6.png

The day is finally here – We Need to Go Deeper’s Early Access is now open to the public today on Jules Verne’s birthday! 

Thanks to being able to watch all of the WNTGD content on Youtube and Twitch, we had the opportunity to make some adjustments before our big day:

The Launch Update

Health Elixers! – After witnessing so many crews fall to the horrors that lie within undersea caves, we decided to introduce a new helpful loot type that can be found inside treasure chests – the amazing Health Elixer! Drink up during cave expeditions and mend those mandible-induced wounds.

New Rare Enemy Types! – A few mysterious new enemy types have been sprinkled into the various biome spawns – from creatures who sing to toothy mutations, there is now more to discover; and more to fear.

New and Improved AI Dungeon Master! – After a lot of number crunching and some BIG Excel sheets, we have wrangled our AI Dungeon Master to be much fairer and hopefully much more diverse in how it calculates the route to your team’s eventual demise.

New Boss: The Megalodon! – Okay, in fairness, a new placeholder boss, but with a whole new big scary look. The Megalodon has made his arrival to the Prehistoric Biome, and though he won’t be here forever, he’s sure to make his presence known.

Obituary Stats! – No more statting stats! Instead, you can stat some actual stats! Deaths, Revives, Damage output and more is now tracked to your character during playthroughs! Post mortem bragging rights is now finally a thing.

Enemy Knockback! – We gave your torpedoes the extra OOMPH they need to halt incoming enemies in their tracks, and send others flying into each other! With Enemy Knockback, you can now buy yourself time before that tentacle monstrosity can latch onto your sub by blasting it in the face.

A Crab Ton of Bug and Balance Fixes! – Last but not least, we’ve been working our tails off to fix, refine, and tune things constantly as we’ve seen playthroughs reveal new annoyances and exploits. From being able to put torpedoes back where you found them, to fixing and improving the way enemies are networked. We have been doing all we can to put the spit-shine on launch day.

Player of the Month

In addition to all of that, I am also happy to announce our first official Player of the Month! While I can appreciate the fact that technically no one is really a “player” yet since the game just came out, we’re giving the inaugural title to member of the We Need to Go Deeper community – 

ᴿᴺᴳ Charlie Brown!

ᴿᴺᴳ Charlie Brown has not only been with the WNTGD community for several years now, but is in fact responsible for starting the first official We Need to Go Deeper community Steam group right after we first got Greenlit on Steam in 2014. Since then, ᴿᴺᴳ Charlie Brown has promoted continued discussion of the game in their discussion boards, starting a semi-regular Q&A with the developers, and has kept the WNTGD torch lit even long after it seemed the game might be dead in the water. For all these reasons, and for just being an all-around nice fella, ᴿᴺᴳ Charlie Brown is our first Player of the Month.

ᴿᴺᴳ Charlie Brown will be receiving 4 free keys to WNTGD to hand out to friends and family for this achievement, and as you will all notice will be recognized on the title screen for this first month.

Our first planned Content Update will be one month from now – March 8th, and we’ll try and push patches and hotfixes along the way as needed. Thanks everybody for your support, and happy diving!

Enemy Knockback! – We gave your torpedoes the extra OOMPH they need to halt incoming enemies in their tracks, and send others flying into each other! With Enemy Knockback, you can now buy yourself time before that tentacle monstrosity can latch onto your sub by blasting it in the face.

A Crab Ton of Bug and Balance Fixes! – Last but not least, we’ve been working our tails off to fix, refine, and tune things constantly as we’ve seen playthroughs reveal new annoyances and exploits. From being able to put torpedoes back where you found them, to fixing and improving the way enemies are networked. We have been doing all we can to put the spit-shine on launch day.

Player of the Month

In addition to all of that, I am also happy to announce our first official Player of the Month! While I can appreciate the fact that technically no one is really a “player” yet since the game just came out, we’re giving the inaugural title to member of the We Need to Go Deeper community – 

ᴿᴺᴳ Charlie Brown!

ᴿᴺᴳ Charlie Brown has not only been with the WNTGD community for several years now, but is in fact responsible for starting the first official We Need to Go Deeper community Steam group right after we first got Greenlit on Steam in 2014. Since then, ᴿᴺᴳ Charlie Brown has promoted continued discussion of the game in their discussion boards, starting a semi-regular Q&A with the developers, and has kept the WNTGD torch lit even long after it seemed the game might be dead in the water. For all these reasons, and for just being an all-around nice fella, ᴿᴺᴳ Charlie Brown is our first Player of the Month.

ᴿᴺᴳ Charlie Brown will be receiving 4 free keys to WNTGD to hand out to friends and family for this achievement, and as you will all notice will be recognized on the title screen for this first month.

Our first planned Content Update will be one month from now – March 8th, and we’ll try and push patches and hotfixes along the way as needed. Thanks everybody for your support, and happy diving!
